definition_zh: 洋流；海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体
definition_en: a continuous, directed flow of seawater, set in motion by winds, by differences in temperature and salinity, or by tides
core_image: 海面或深海里藏着一条看不见的河，两岸都是海水，水却固执地朝同一侧走
scene: 海洋课上，老师指着海图上从热带伸向高纬的蓝色带子说，An ocean current carries warm water far from the equator.
sceneCN: 这里 ocean current 指「海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体」（第 1 个义项：泛指洋流）；句意为：一股洋流把暖水从赤道带向远方。

pos.zh: 洋流；海洋中沿固定方向持续流动的水体

derivatives.zh: 西边界流（沿大洋西缘向极地流动的强而窄的洋流）
边界流；沿海岸或海盆边缘流动的洋流
风生流；由盛行风推动的表层洋流
海流计；测量流速与流向的仪器
温盐流；由温度与盐度差异驱动的深层水流

senses.title: Seawater that keeps to one direction
senses.titleCN: 沿固定方向持续流动的海水
senses.definition: a continuous, directed movement of seawater that persists over long distances
senses.definitionCN: 在长距离上持续保持同一方向的海水流动
senses.example: An ocean current can be as steady as a river in its channel.
senses.exampleCN: 一股洋流可以像河道里的河水一样稳定。
senses.why: the phrase simply names the sea's version of a river: water that runs in a channel of its own, marked out by heat, salt and wind rather than by banks.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语只是给海里那条「河」命名：水在自己的通道里奔跑，通道由热、盐与风划定，而不是由河岸划定。

senses.title: The wind-driven surface flow
senses.definition: the current in the upper ocean, set in motion and shaped by the prevailing winds
senses.definitionCN: 上层海洋中由盛行风驱动并塑造的水流
senses.example: The trade winds drive a surface ocean current westward along the equator.
senses.exampleCN: 信风驱动表层洋流沿赤道向西流动。
senses.why: wind drags the top of the sea the way it drags a cloth, so the uppermost layer becomes the current that pulls the rest along.
senses.whyCN: 风拖动海面，像拖动一块布，于是最上面那层水成了拖动其余水体的洋流。

senses.title: The density-driven deep flow
senses.definition: the slow current of cold, dense water in the deep ocean, driven by differences in temperature and salt
senses.definitionCN: 深海中由温度与盐分差异驱动的寒冷高密度水的缓慢流动
senses.example: A deep ocean current carries Antarctic water north along the sea floor.
senses.exampleCN: 一股深层洋流沿海底把南极的水向北输送。
senses.why: cold and salty water is heavy, so it sinks and pushes along the bottom; gravity, not wind, is the engine here.
senses.whyCN: 又冷又咸的水更重，于是下沉并沿底部推进；这里的动力是重力，不是风。

senses.title: The narrow current at a coast
senses.titleCN: 沿海岸流动的窄而急的水流
senses.definition: a strong, narrow current that runs along the edge of a continent, such as the Gulf Stream or the Kuroshio
senses.definitionCN: 沿大陆边缘流动的强劲窄流，如墨西哥湾流或黑潮
senses.example: This boundary ocean current keeps the harbour ice-free in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这股边界洋流使港口在冬季不结冰。
senses.why: water piled against a coast has only the edge to escape along, so it narrows and speeds up, which is why such currents are the fastest in the sea.
senses.whyCN: 被堆到岸边的水只能沿边缘找出路，于是变窄、加速，这正是这类洋流成为海中流速最快者的原因。

senses.title: The currents along the equator
senses.definition: the eastward and westward currents that run parallel to the equator, driven by the trade winds
senses.definitionCN: 与赤道平行、由信风驱动的向东与向西水流
senses.example: Equatorial ocean currents shift eastward when the trade winds relax.
senses.exampleCN: 信风减弱时，赤道洋流向东移动。
senses.why: the equator is where the winds are steadiest, so the currents there become the most regular lanes in the ocean.
senses.whyCN: 赤道一带风最稳定，因此那里的洋流成了海洋中最规律的通道。

senses.title: The current that follows the tide
senses.definition: the horizontal movement of water produced by the rise and fall of the tide, reversing direction through the day
senses.definitionCN: 由潮汐涨落引起的水平水流，一天之内改变方向
senses.example: Where the tide runs hard, the ocean current reverses with it.
senses.exampleCN: 在潮水强劲处，洋流也随之反向。
senses.why: the tide does not only lift the surface; it also drags water sideways, and that horizontal part is read as a current.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐并不只是抬高水面，它还会横向拖动海水，而这一横向部分就被看作水流。

senses.title: The current that follows a shore
senses.definition: a current that runs parallel to a shoreline, often carrying sediment and larvae along the coast
senses.definitionCN: 与海岸线平行流动的水流，常沿岸输送泥沙与幼体
senses.example: A coastal ocean current moves sand southward along the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 一股沿岸洋流沿海滩把沙向南搬运。
senses.why: waves breaking at an angle push water along the shore, so the beach itself generates a current that follows its own line.
senses.whyCN: 斜向破碎的波浪把水沿岸推挤，海滩因而生成一股沿着自身轮廓流动的水流。

senses.title: The current as a carrier of heat
senses.definition: a current regarded as a conveyor that moves heat, salt and carbon between latitudes and basins
senses.definitionCN: 被视作在纬度与海盆之间输送热量、盐分与碳的水流
senses.example: The ocean current releases its heat to the air over the northern Atlantic.
senses.exampleCN: 这股洋流把热量释放给北大西洋上空的空气。
senses.why: once the flow is mapped, it stops being only water and becomes a carrier: what it transports matters more than what it is.
senses.whyCN: 水流一旦被测绘成图，它就不只是水，而成为载体：它输送什么，比它本身是什么更重要。

senses.title: The current as a route
senses.definition: a current used as a path by drifting organisms, ships or floating debris
senses.definitionCN: 被漂流生物、船只或漂浮物当作路径使用的水流
senses.example: Larvae travel on the ocean current from the reef to the nursery ground.
senses.exampleCN: 幼体随这股洋流从珊瑚礁前往育幼场。
senses.why: anything that floats and cannot swim has no choice of direction, so the current becomes its road.
senses.whyCN: 任何漂浮且不会游动的东西都无法选择方向，于是洋流就成了它的路。

intro.en: Ocean current is a compound of two borrowed words: ocean from Greek Okeanos by way of Latin and Old French, current from Latin currere 'to run'. The fixed phrase belongs to the language of navigation and nineteenth-century oceanography. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ocean current 由两个外来词复合而成：ocean 出自希腊 Okeanos，经拉丁语与古法语传来；current 出自拉丁 currere「跑」。这一固定短语属于航海语言与 19 世纪海洋学写作。年代均为约数。

items.en: Greek Okeanos, the river thought to encircle the world, became Latin Oceanus and Old French occean, and named the great salt water in English.
items.cn: 希腊 Okeanos 是古人想象中环绕世界的大河，后为拉丁 Oceanus 与古法语 occean，在英语中指巨大的咸水体。

items.en: Latin currens, current- 'running' gave Old French corant and English current, first of running water and later of moving air and charge.
items.cn: 拉丁 currens, current-「跑着的」产生古法语 corant 与英语 current，先指流动的水，后指流动的空气与电荷。

items.en: By the sixteenth century sailors were recording currents at sea, and the plain noun current was enough; the compound was not yet fixed.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，水手已在记录海上的水流，单用名词 current 就够；复合短语尚未固定。

items.en: When wind and current charts were published for navigators in the nineteenth century, ocean current settled as the standard term of the new science of the sea.
items.cn: 19 世纪为航海者刊行风与海流图时，ocean current 固定下来，成为新兴海洋科学的标准术语。

items.en: Twentieth-century physical oceanography classified ocean currents by their driver and position: surface, deep, boundary, equatorial, coastal and tidal.
items.cn: 20 世纪的物理海洋学按驱动因素与位置把洋流分类：表层、深层、边界、赤道、沿岸与潮流。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date of the compound only, not the roots): the exact first use of the phrase is not fixed, and its spread is generally associated with nineteenth-century chart-making rather than with a single author; both component roots are well documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅就复合短语的首见年代，不涉及词根）：该短语最早的用例没有确切年份，其流行一般认为是随 19 世纪制图而扩散，而非出自某位作者；两个构词成分的词根文献确凿。

note.en: Group one holds forms built from the same two words or near neighbours of the compound; group two holds other names for moving water that differ in scale or cause.
note.cn: 第一组是由同样两个词构成、或与该短语相邻的说法；第二组是其他指流动之水的名称，规模或成因不同。

entries.definition: the single word covers water, air and electricity; only the compound keeps the meaning inside the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 单独一个词可指水、空气与电；只有复合短语把意义限定在海里。

entries.definition: a less technical variant using sea instead of ocean; it is correct but occurs far less often in oceanography.
entries.definitionCN: 用 sea 代替 ocean 的不太技术的变体；说法正确，但在海洋学文献中远不常见。

entries.definition: a current produced by the tide alone; it is a kind of ocean current but is named for its cause rather than its place.
entries.definitionCN: 仅由潮汐产生的水流；它属于洋流的一种，但按成因而非按地点命名。

entries.definition: the whole system of flows, including wind-driven and density-driven parts; a current is one strand within it.
entries.definitionCN: 指整个流动系统，包括风驱动与密度驱动的部分；洋流只是其中一股。

entries.definition: in oceanography a stream is a narrow, well-defined current, as in the Florida Stream; the scale is smaller.
entries.definitionCN: 在海洋学中指狭窄而边界清楚的水流，如佛罗里达流；尺度更小。

entries.definition: the general movement of surface water under wind; it stresses displacement rather than a fixed channel.
entries.definitionCN: 表层水在风下的整体移动；强调位移，而不强调固定通道。

entries.definition: a large closed loop formed by several currents around a basin; it is the loop, not one current in it.
entries.definitionCN: 由数股洋流绕海盆形成的大型闭合环路；它指整个环路，而非其中一股洋流。

entries.definition: a swirl of water that has broken away from the main flow; it spins instead of travelling in one direction.
entries.definitionCN: 脱离主流的旋转水团；它打转，而不是朝一个方向长途行进。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: A current is a river inside the sea: ocean names the water, current names the running.
normal.cn: 洋流是海里的一条河：ocean 命名水域，current 命名奔跑。

normal.en: The phrase is a compound noun, so its plural is ocean currents.
normal.cn: 这个短语是复合名词，复数为 ocean currents。

normal.en: Its classes follow the driver: wind at the surface, density in the deep, tide at the coast.
normal.cn: 它的分类跟着驱动因素走：表层靠风，深层靠密度，沿岸靠潮。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: surface ocean current, deep ocean current, warm ocean current, ocean current system.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：表层洋流、深层洋流、暖洋流、洋流系统。

normal.en: The single word current also covers air and electricity; only the compound keeps it in the sea.
normal.cn: 单用的 current 也指空气与电；只有这个复合短语把它留在海里。

abstract.en: Picture a ribbon laid on the water and followed for thousands of kilometres.
abstract.cn: 想象一条铺在水上的缎带，被追随了数千公里。

abstract.en: Picture a bottle thrown into the sea arriving on a beach it never chose.
abstract.cn: 想象一只被扔进海里的瓶子，抵达一片它从未选择的沙滩。

abstract.en: Picture a warm room built into cold water and moving slowly north.
abstract.cn: 想象一间造在冷水里的暖房，正缓慢向北移动。

examples.en: The Gulf Stream is the best-known warm ocean current in the Atlantic.
examples.cn: 墨西哥湾流是大西洋中最著名的暖洋流。

examples.en: Deep ocean currents move water that has not seen the surface for centuries.
examples.cn: 深层洋流搬运着数百年未见过表层的水。

examples.en: Sailors once relied on an ocean current to shorten a crossing.
examples.cn: 水手曾依靠洋流来缩短航程。

dict_mnemonic.note: 拆词＋谐音记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧申＋卡润特」——大洋里那股一直「跑」的水 → 洋流

root: 复合短语：ocean（希腊 Okeanos「环绕世界的大河」→ 拉丁 Oceanus → 古法语 occean）+ current（拉丁 currere「跑」的现在分词 currens, current- → 古法语 corant）；在海洋学写作中固化为「洋流」；Okeanos 的更早来源有争议，currere 的印欧来源一般重构为 *kers-「跑」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one stream: the general flow, then the layer the wind drives, the deep water that density drives, the fast edge currents, the equatorial lanes, the tidal and coastal versions, and finally the current as a carrier of heat and as a road for drifters.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一股水流：先是一般的洋流，然后是风驱动的表层、密度驱动的深层、沿岸的急流、赤道的通道、潮汐与沿岸的变体，最后是作为热量载体与漂流者通道的洋流。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a river inside the sea, with water for both banks and a direction of its own.
core.cn: 核心意象：海里的一条河，两岸都是水，而它有自己坚定的方向。

branches.en: THE FLOW ITSELF: first the general stream, then the upper layer that the wind drags with it.
branches.cn: 流动本身：先是一般的洋流，然后是被风拖动的最上层。

branches.en: THE DEEP AND THE EDGE: heavy water sinks and runs along the bottom, while water piled at a coast races along it.
branches.cn: 深处与边缘：重水下沉并沿底部奔跑，而被堆到岸边的水则沿岸疾走。

branches.en: LATITUDE AND CLOCK: the steadiest lanes follow the equator, and the most regular reversals follow the tide.
branches.cn: 纬度与时钟：最稳定的通道沿赤道，最规律的往复随潮汐。

branches.en: ALONG THE SHORE: sediment and larvae travel parallel to the beach on a current of its own.
branches.cn: 沿岸：泥沙与幼体顺着一股自成的沿岸流，与海滩平行地移动。

branches.en: WHAT IT CARRIES: the current as a conveyor of heat and salt, and as a road for anything that drifts.
branches.cn: 它载着什么：洋流既是热与盐的输送带，也是任何漂流之物的路。

intro.en: Ocean current is a two-word technical compound; its parts come from Greek and Latin, and the same pieces recur in the vocabulary of the sea.
intro.cn: ocean current 是双词技术复合语；两部分分别来自希腊语与拉丁语，同样的构件在海洋词汇中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin Oceanus supplies ocean and its relatives, while Latin currere supplies current and the whole family of course and cursor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 Oceanus 提供 ocean 及其同族词，拉丁 currere 则提供 current 以及 course、cursor 整族词。

items.exampleCN: 荷马把 Okeanos 放在已知世界的边缘。

items.structure: Okeanos → Latin Oceanus → Old French occean
items.example: The ocean stores most of the planet's heat.
items.exampleCN: 海洋储存了这颗行星的大部分热量。

items.exampleCN: currere 同时给出 current 与 course。

items.example: Currens aqua is water that runs.

items.meaning: a steady flow of water, air or charge
items.meaningCN: 水、空气或电荷的稳定流动
items.example: The current bent the buoy line.
items.exampleCN: 水流把浮标缆绳拉弯了。

items.example: An ocean current can persist for years.
items.exampleCN: 一股洋流可以持续多年。

items.example: Ocean currents redistribute heat between latitudes.
items.exampleCN: 洋流在纬度之间重新分配热量。

items.example: Oceanic water is usually clearer than coastal water.
items.exampleCN: 外海水通常比沿岸水清澈。

items.meaning: an instrument for measuring flow speed
items.example: The current-meter logged the flow all winter.
items.exampleCN: 海流计记录了整个冬季的流速。

items.meaning: moved or powered by a current
items.example: Current-driven mixing brings nutrients upward.
items.exampleCN: 由水流驱动的混合把营养盐带向上方。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 外围的大海；亦为海神之名

senses.title: Of heat and salt together
senses.definition: relating to temperature and salinity considered together as a pair of properties
senses.definitionCN: 把温度与盐度作为成对属性一并考虑的
senses.example: Every water sample has a thermohaline signature.
senses.exampleCN: 每个水样都带有温盐特征。
senses.why: Greek thermē 'heat' supplies the first half and halinos 'of salt' the second, with -ine joining them: the word names a pair, not a single quantity.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 thermē「热」提供前半，halinos「盐的」提供后半，再由 -ine 连接：这个词命名的是一对属性，而不是单一量值。

senses.title: Controlling density
senses.definition: describing the pair of properties that together fix the density of seawater
senses.definitionCN: 描述共同决定海水密度的两项属性
senses.example: Density is a thermohaline property of sea water.
senses.exampleCN: 密度是海水的一项温盐属性。
senses.why: cold water and salty water are both heavier, so heat and salt pull on the same lever; calling density thermohaline says which two dials control it.
senses.whyCN: 冷水和咸水都更重，热与盐拉的是同一根杠杆；把密度称为 thermohaline，就是说明哪两个旋钮在控制它。

senses.title: Driving the deep overturning
senses.definition: describing the temperature and salt differences that set the deep ocean circulation in motion
senses.definitionCN: 描述推动深层海洋环流运转的温度与盐度差异
senses.example: The deep flow is thermohaline in origin, not wind-driven.
senses.exampleCN: 这股深层流源于温盐作用，而不是风。
senses.why: wind moves the top of the sea, but sinking needs weight; only heat and salt can make water heavy enough to go down.
senses.whyCN: 风只动海面，下沉却需要重量；只有热与盐能让水重到可以往下走。

senses.title: Layering the water column
senses.definition: describing the layering of the water column that results from combined temperature and salinity differences
senses.definitionCN: 描述由温度与盐度差异共同造成的水柱分层
senses.example: A thermohaline boundary separates the two water masses.
senses.exampleCN: 一道温盐界面把两个水团分开。
senses.why: different heat and salt make water of different weight, and weight settles into layers instead of mixing away.
senses.whyCN: 不同的热与盐造出不同重量的水，而重量会沉淀成层，而不是混掉。

senses.title: Marking a water mass
senses.definition: describing the temperature and salinity values used to identify a particular body of water
senses.definitionCN: 描述用来辨认某一特定水体的温度与盐度数值
senses.example: Charting thermohaline properties lets a ship trace where a parcel came from.
senses.exampleCN: 测绘温盐性质能让船只追溯一块水来自何处。
senses.why: a water mass keeps the heat and salt it acquired at the surface, so the pair works as a label that travels with it.
senses.whyCN: 一个水团保留着它在表层获得的热与盐，因此这对数值成了随它旅行的标签。

senses.title: Forcing in a climate model
senses.titleCN: 气候模式中的温盐强迫
senses.definition: describing the surface fluxes of heat and fresh water that a climate model applies as thermohaline forcing
senses.definitionCN: 描述气候模式作为温盐强迫施加的热量与淡水通量
senses.example: The model applies thermohaline forcing at the high latitudes.
senses.exampleCN: 该模式在高纬地区施加温盐强迫。
senses.why: a model cannot move the ocean itself, so it must be given the heat and salt exchanges that will make water move.
senses.whyCN: 模式本身搬不动整个海洋，因此必须交给它那些会让水动起来的热量与盐分交换。

senses.title: The conveyor image
senses.definition: describing the slow global loop imagined as a conveyor belt driven by heat and salt
senses.definitionCN: 描述被想象成由热与盐驱动的全球缓慢环路
senses.example: The thermohaline conveyor is a shorthand for a loop no ship can follow in one lifetime.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐传送带是对一个没有船能在一生中走完的环路的简称。
senses.why: the loop is too slow and too large to see, so it is pictured as a belt: a mechanism, not a place.
senses.whyCN: 这个环路太慢太大，看不见，于是被画成一条传送带：一个机制，而不是一个地点。

senses.title: On a millennial clock
senses.definition: describing processes whose timescale runs to centuries or millennia rather than to seasons
senses.definitionCN: 描述时间尺度以百年或千年计而非以季节计的过程
senses.example: Thermohaline change is measured on a millennial clock.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐变化以千年的尺度来衡量。
senses.why: water that sinks must cross the whole basin before it rises, and that journey outlasts any human career.
senses.whyCN: 下沉的水要走完整个海盆才能重新上升，这段旅程比任何人的职业生涯都长。

senses.title: A signal in the sediment
senses.definition: describing ancient temperature and salinity conditions reconstructed from sediment or ice records
senses.definitionCN: 描述从沉积物或冰芯记录中重建的古代温度与盐度状况
senses.example: A thermohaline shift in the core matches the end of the cold period.
senses.exampleCN: 岩芯中的温盐突变与寒冷期的结束相对应。
senses.why: shells and salts preserve the heat and salt of the water they formed in, so the pair becomes a readable trace of a vanished sea.
senses.whyCN: 贝壳与盐类保留着它们形成时水中的热与盐，于是这对数值成了对一片消失之海的可用痕迹。

intro.en: Thermohaline is a nineteenth-century scientific compound of two Greek stems: thermē 'heat' and hals 'salt' with its adjective halinos, joined by the English suffix -ine. It names water by the two properties that fix its density. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: thermohaline 是 19 世纪的科学复合词，由两个希腊词干构成：thermē「热」与 hals「盐」（及其形容词 halinos），再用英语后缀 -ine 连接；它以决定水密度的两项属性来命名水。年代均为约数。

items.en: Thermē 'heat' comes from thermos 'hot', the stem behind thermometer and thermic; it names the state, not the fire that produces it.
items.cn: thermē「热」来自 thermos「热的」，也是 thermometer 与 thermic 的词干；它命名状态，而不是产生热的火。

items.en: Hals, halos means 'salt' and also 'sea'; the adjective halinos 'of salt' is the form English borrowed for the second half of the compound.
items.cn: hals, halos 意为「盐」，也指「海」；形容词 halinos「盐的」就是英语借来构成复合词后半的形式。

items.en: The adjective ending -ine, from Latin -inus and French -ine, was the standard way nineteenth-century science turned a noun into a property adjective.
items.cn: 形容词词尾 -ine 来自拉丁 -inus 与法语 -ine，是 19 世纪科学把名词变成性质形容词的标准手段。

items.en: Physical oceanography needed a word for the pair of controls on density, and the Greek stems were joined rather than a phrase invented; the compound names what it measures.
items.cn: 物理海洋学需要一个词指控制密度的这对因素，于是把希腊词干拼接起来，而不是另造短语；这个复合词命名了它所测量的东西。

items.en: The compound became familiar through thermohaline circulation and the conveyor image, so the adjective now usually appears attached to circulation or stratification.
items.cn: 这个复合词通过温盐环流与传送带意象而为人熟知，因此如今这个形容词通常与 circulation 或 stratification 连用。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and coiner, not the roots): the exact author and year of the first use are not established, and the PIE sources of both thermos and hals are reconstructions rather than attested forms.
items.cn: 来源不确定（指首见年代与造词者，不涉及词根）：最早用例的作者与年份没有定论；thermos 与 hals 的印欧来源均为重构形式，而非有文献可查的形式。

note.en: Group one holds words that share one of the two Greek halves; group two holds words about salt, heat, density and layering that each cover only part of the idea.
note.cn: 第一组是共享两个希腊成分之一的词；第二组是关于盐、热、密度与分层的词，各自只覆盖这一概念的一部分。

entries.definition: relating to heat alone; it comes from the same Greek thermē but says nothing about salt.
entries.definitionCN: 只与热有关；同出希腊 thermē，却完全不涉及盐。

entries.definition: of or containing salt; it is the second half of thermohaline standing alone, with no heat in it.
entries.definitionCN: 盐的、含盐的；它是 thermohaline 的后半单独成词，其中没有热。

entries.definition: a layer of rapid temperature change in water; it shares therm- but names a boundary, not a pair of properties.
entries.definitionCN: 水中温度急剧变化的一层；共享 therm-，但命名的是一个界面，而不是一对属性。

entries.definition: a layer of rapid salinity change; it is the salt counterpart of the thermocline, and again a boundary rather than a property pair.
entries.definitionCN: 盐度急剧变化的一层；它是温跃层的盐度对应物，同样是一个界面而非一对属性。

entries.definition: containing salt; it measures one half of what thermohaline measures and ignores temperature.
entries.definitionCN: 含盐的；它只涉及 thermohaline 所量的一半，不涉及温度。

entries.definition: mass per unit volume; thermohaline properties are what make seawater density vary, so density is the outcome.
entries.definitionCN: 单位体积的质量；温盐性质是使海水密度变化的原因，因此密度是结果。

entries.definition: the arrangement of water in layers; thermohaline differences produce it, but the word itself says nothing about heat or salt.
entries.definitionCN: 水成层排列的状态；温盐差异造成这种排列，但这个词本身不涉及热或盐。

entries.definition: the upward force a fluid exerts; thermohaline contrasts create buoyancy differences, which is how they move water.
entries.definitionCN: 流体施加的向上之力；温盐差异造成浮力差，从而推动水运动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: therm- is heat: thermometer, thermal and thermocline all start here.
normal.cn: therm- 就是热：thermometer、thermal、thermocline 都从这里开始。

normal.en: hal- is salt: halite is rock salt, and haline means salty.
normal.cn: hal- 就是盐：halite 是岩盐，haline 意为含盐的。

normal.en: -ine is the adjective ending that turns a noun into a property, as in saline and marine.
normal.cn: -ine 是把名词变成性质形容词的词尾，如 saline 与 marine。

normal.en: The compound names its own cause: heat plus salt give density, and density drives the deep flow.
normal.cn: 这个复合词点明了自己的成因：热加盐给出密度，密度再驱动深层流。

normal.en: Its usual partners are fixed: thermohaline circulation, thermohaline stratification, thermohaline forcing.
normal.cn: 它的固定搭配很有限：温盐环流、温盐层化、温盐强迫。

abstract.en: Picture two dials on one bucket, one marked heat and one marked salt, both wired to the same scale.
abstract.cn: 想象桶上有两个旋钮，一个标热，一个标盐，都接到同一块刻度盘上。

abstract.en: Picture water that is too heavy to stay on top and has no choice but to sink.
abstract.cn: 想象水重得无法留在上层，除了下沉别无选择。

abstract.en: Picture a layer of water that refuses to mix with the layer beneath it.
abstract.cn: 想象一层水拒绝与它下面那层混合。

examples.en: Thermohaline differences make the deep water heavy enough to sink.
examples.cn: 温盐差异使深层水重到足以下沉。

examples.en: The basin's thermohaline structure changed after the ice melted.
examples.cn: 冰融化后，该海盆的温盐结构发生了改变。

examples.en: Models treat heat and fresh water as thermohaline forcing.
examples.cn: 模式把热量与淡水当作温盐强迫来处理。

dict_mnemonic.note: 拆词＋谐音记忆 · 非词源
dict_mnemonic.text: 「热么？海盐」——热与盐一起称量海水，决定它轻重 → 温盐的

root: 希腊 thermē「热」+ hals, halos「盐」的形容词 halinos「盐的」+ 英语后缀 -ine → thermohaline；19 世纪科学复合词，指温度与盐度共同作用；两个词根均属希腊语，无拉丁同族；thermē 与 hals 的更早印欧来源均为重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one pair of dials: heat and salt named together, density fixed by them, sinking driven by density, layers formed, water masses labelled, model forcing supplied, the loop pictured as a belt, its slow clock, and its trace in old sediment.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一对旋钮：热与盐并称、二者定下密度、密度驱动下沉、由此成层、给水团贴标签、给模式提供强迫、把环路画成传送带、它缓慢的时钟，以及它在古老沉积物中的痕迹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two gauges in the same bucket, one reading heat and one reading salt, their two numbers deciding how heavy the water is.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一桶水里的两支量表，一支读热，一支读盐，两个读数决定这水有多重。

branches.en: THE TWO DIALS: heat and salt are named together because together they set density.
branches.cn: 两个旋钮：热与盐并称，因为二者合力定下密度。

branches.en: WHAT MAKES WATER MOVE: the same pair drives sinking in the sea and appears as forcing in a model.
branches.cn: 让水动起来的东西：同一对因素在海里驱动下沉，在模式里则表现为强迫。

branches.en: WHAT IT LEAVES BEHIND: layers in the column, and a signature that identifies a water mass.
branches.cn: 它留下的东西：水柱中的分层，以及辨认一个水团的标记。

branches.en: THE SLOW LOOP: pictured as a conveyor and measured on a millennial clock.
branches.cn: 缓慢的环路：被画成传送带，并以千年为尺度计量。

branches.en: A TRACE IN MUD: the pair survives in sediment as a record of an old sea.
branches.cn: 泥中的痕迹：这对数值在沉积物里留存，成为一片古海的记录。

intro.en: Thermohaline is a scientific compound made of two Greek roots and one English suffix; the same three pieces build the vocabulary of temperature and salt in water.
intro.cn: thermohaline 是由两个希腊词根加一个英语后缀构成的科学复合词；同样的三个构件搭建起水中温度与盐分的词汇。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin relative of this word: both roots are Greek, and only the suffix -ine reached English through Latin -inus and French -ine.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁同族：两个词根都是希腊语，只有后缀 -ine 是经拉丁 -inus 与法语 -ine 进入英语的。

items.example: Thermē gave English the stem therm-.
items.exampleCN: thermē 给英语留下了 therm- 这个词干。

items.example: Thermos is the adjective behind thermē.
items.exampleCN: thermos 是 thermē 背后的形容词。

items.example: Hals appears in halite and in halocline.
items.exampleCN: hals 出现在 halite 与 halocline 中。

items.example: Halinos supplies the middle of the compound.
items.exampleCN: halinos 提供了这个复合词的中段。

items.meaning: belonging to, of the nature of
items.example: Saline, marine and thermohaline share this ending.
items.exampleCN: saline、marine 与 thermohaline 共用这个词尾。

items.example: Thermohaline properties decide how dense the water is.
items.exampleCN: 温盐性质决定水有多重。

items.meaning: a layer where temperature falls sharply
items.example: The thermocline blocks mixing between two layers.
items.exampleCN: 温跃层阻隔了两层之间的混合。

items.meaning: a layer where salinity changes sharply
items.example: A halocline can keep fresh water on top of salt water.
items.exampleCN: 盐跃层能把淡水保持在咸水之上。

items.example: Haline water is denser than fresh water.
items.exampleCN: 含盐的水比淡水更重。

items.example: The thermometer reads the temperature of the sample.
items.exampleCN: 温度计读出样品的温度。

definition_zh: 温盐环流；由温度与盐度差异驱动的全球深层海洋环流
definition_en: the large-scale overturning circulation of the ocean, driven by differences in seawater temperature and salinity and moving deep water between basins over centuries
core_image: 极地海面结冰析出盐分，剩水更冷更咸而下沉，沿深海铺展到远处，再从另一侧缓缓升回海面，绕成一圈
scene: 气候课上，老师沿着全球海图画出从北大西洋下沉、绕过南极再回到北太平洋的长箭头说，Thermohaline circulation returns deep water to the surface centuries later.
sceneCN: 这里 thermohaline circulation 指「由温度与盐度差异驱动的全球深层海洋环流」（第 1 个义项：总称）；句意为：温盐环流在数百年之后才把深层水送回海面。

pos.zh: 温盐环流；温盐传送带

derivatives.zh: 大西洋经向翻转环流（该环流在大西洋的系统）
翻转环流；深层水上翻、表层水下沉的环流
经向翻转；沿南北方向的垂直翻转
传送带（对这一全球环流系统的比喻称呼）
深层水形成；表层水下沉成为深层水的环节

senses.title: The overturning loop as a whole
senses.definition: the global-scale circulation in which dense water sinks in a few cold regions and returns to the surface elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 高密度水在少数寒冷海域下沉、又在别处回到表层的全球尺度环流
senses.example: Thermohaline circulation links all the major ocean basins.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐环流把所有主要海盆连在一起。
senses.why: the compound names its own cause: heat and salt make the density differences, and circulation names the loop those differences produce.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词点明了自己的成因：热与盐造成密度差，circulation 则指这些差异所生成的环路。

senses.title: The sinking limb
senses.definition: the part of the loop where surface water cools, becomes dense and descends
senses.definitionCN: 环路中表层水冷却、变重并下潜的那一段
senses.example: The sinking limb of thermohaline circulation begins in the northern Atlantic.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐环流的下沉支始于北大西洋北部。
senses.why: a loop has to start somewhere, and it starts where water can lose heat fast enough to become heavier than what lies beneath it.
senses.whyCN: 环路总得从某处开始，而它开始于水能迅速失热、重到超过下方水体的地方。

senses.title: The returning limb
senses.definition: the part of the loop in which deep water travels through the basins and slowly rises
senses.definitionCN: 环路中深层水穿行各海盆并缓慢上升的那一段
senses.example: The returning limb of thermohaline circulation is spread over the whole Indian and Pacific oceans.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐环流的回流支分布在整个印度洋与太平洋。
senses.why: water that went down must come up before it can go down again, and this long return takes most of the loop's travel time.
senses.whyCN: 下去的水必须先上来才能再下去，而这段漫长的回程占去了环路的大部分行程时间。

senses.title: The conveyor belt image
senses.definition: the popular image of the loop as a single belt carrying water, heat and carbon around the globe
senses.definitionCN: 把环路想象成绕地球输送水、热量与碳的一条传送带的流行说法
senses.example: The conveyor belt image made thermohaline circulation familiar outside oceanography.
senses.exampleCN: 传送带这一意象使温盐环流在海洋学之外也为人熟知。
senses.why: no observer can watch a loop that takes centuries, so it is drawn as a belt with stations, and that is how it entered textbooks.
senses.whyCN: 没人能观看一个耗时数百年的环路，于是它被画成带站点的传送带，也就这样进入了教科书。

senses.title: A heat transport system
senses.definition: the loop considered as the mechanism that redistributes heat between the tropics and the poles
senses.definitionCN: 被视作在热带与极地之间重新分配热量的机制
senses.example: Thermohaline circulation keeps the northern Atlantic warmer than its latitude alone would allow.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐环流使北大西洋比单凭纬度所能允许的更暖。
senses.why: the same water that carries salt carries heat, so the loop works as a heating system with an ocean for pipes.
senses.whyCN: 载盐的水同时载热，因此这个环路像一套以海洋为管道的供暖系统。

senses.title: A carrier of carbon and nutrients
senses.definition: the loop considered as a conveyor of dissolved carbon, oxygen and nutrients into the deep sea
senses.definitionCN: 被视作把溶解碳、氧与营养盐送入深海的输送系统
senses.example: Thermohaline circulation buries carbon in the deep ocean for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 温盐环流把碳封存在深海中数百年。
senses.why: deep water is out of contact with the air, so whatever it carries down stays down until the loop brings it back.
senses.whyCN: 深层水与大气隔绝，因此它带下去的东西一直留在下面，直到环路把它带回来。

senses.title: A cell in a climate model
senses.titleCN: 气候模式中的环流单元
senses.definition: the overturning cell represented in a numerical model of the ocean and climate
senses.definitionCN: 在海洋与气候数值模式中被表示出来的翻转单元
senses.example: The model's thermohaline circulation weakens when fresh water is added at high latitudes.
senses.exampleCN: 当高纬地区淡水增加时，模式中的温盐环流会减弱。
senses.why: a model cannot hold a whole ocean, so the loop is reduced to a cell with a strength number attached.
senses.whyCN: 模式装不下整个海洋，于是环路被简化为一个带强度数值的单元。

senses.title: A past state of the loop
senses.definition: a particular mode of the loop reconstructed for a past climate, such as a weaker glacial mode
senses.definitionCN: 为过去气候重建出的环路特定状态，如较弱的冰期状态
senses.example: Proxy records suggest that thermohaline circulation slowed during the cold period.
senses.exampleCN: 代用指标记录显示温盐环流在寒冷期减慢。
senses.why: the loop leaves traces in sediment and ice, so it can be reconstructed as a state and not only observed as a present process.
senses.whyCN: 环流在沉积物与冰中留下痕迹，因此它能被重建为一种状态，而不只是被观测为当下的过程。

senses.title: A very slow clock
senses.definition: the centennial to millennial timescale on which the loop responds to change
senses.definitionCN: 环路对变化作出响应的百年至千年尺度
senses.example: On the thermohaline circulation's own clock, the recent warming is almost instantaneous.
senses.exampleCN: 按温盐环流自身的时间尺度看，近期的变暖几乎是瞬间发生的。
senses.why: water in the loop takes centuries to complete a circuit, so any change in it is read in centuries rather than in seasons.
senses.whyCN: 环路中的水要数百年才走完一圈，因此它的任何变化都以百年而非季节来度量。

intro.en: Thermohaline circulation joins a Greek-based adjective to a Latin-based noun: thermohaline from thermē 'heat' and halinos 'of salt', circulation from Latin circulatio, a going round. The phrase is a twentieth-century oceanographic compound. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: thermohaline circulation 把一个希腊系形容词与一个拉丁系名词组合起来：thermohaline 出自 thermē「热」与 halinos「盐的」，circulation 出自拉丁 circulatio「绕行」。这一短语是 20 世纪海洋学的复合术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Thermohaline, built in the nineteenth century from thermē 'heat' and halinos 'of salt', supplied the adjective that names the cause of the density differences.
items.cn: thermohaline 于 19 世纪由 thermē「热」与 halinos「盐的」构成，提供了命名密度差异成因的形容词。

items.en: Circulatio comes from circulus 'small ring' and the verb circulare 'to move in a circle'; Latin used it for anything that returns to its starting point.
items.cn: circulatio 来自 circulus「小圆圈」与动词 circulare「绕圈运动」；拉丁语用它指任何回到起点的运动。

items.en: English circulation is recorded from the sixteenth century for movement in a circle, and was extended to the blood and later to the air and the sea.
items.cn: 英语 circulation 的书证见于 16 世纪，指绕圈运动，后来扩展到血液，再扩展到空气与海洋。

items.en: Physical oceanographers of the mid-twentieth century needed a name for the density-driven overturning that wind-driven theory could not explain, and the two existing words were joined.
items.cn: 20 世纪中期的物理海洋学家需要一个名称，指风驱动理论无法解释的密度驱动翻转，于是把两个已有的词拼在一起。

items.en: The phrase spread beyond specialist literature when the loop was popularised as a great conveyor belt in the late twentieth century; that image, not a new coinage, made the term public.
items.cn: 20 世纪后期，这个环路被通俗化为一条巨大的传送带，该短语因而走出专业文献；使这一术语走向公众的是那个意象，而不是新造的词语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first use of the full phrase, not the roots): the exact first appearance and author are not established, and the attribution of the conveyor image to any single paper is generally accepted but not documented step by step.
items.cn: 来源不确定（指完整短语的首见，不涉及词根）：最早出现的时间与作者没有定论；传送带意象归于某篇论文的说法属于「一般认为是」，但缺少逐步文献。

note.en: Group one holds the adjective alone and the broader or mechanism-neutral names built from the same words; group two holds specific branches and parts of the same system.
note.cn: 第一组是单独使用的形容词，以及由同样词汇构成、范围更宽或机制中性的名称；第二组是同一系统中的具体分支与部件。

entries.definition: the adjective describes the heat-and-salt cause; it does not by itself name the loop, which needs circulation.
entries.definitionCN: 这个形容词描述热与盐的成因；它本身并不命名环路，环路还要靠 circulation。

entries.definition: the whole system of ocean flow, wind-driven and density-driven alike; thermohaline circulation is only its density-driven part.
entries.definitionCN: 指海洋流动的整个系统，风驱动与密度驱动都算；温盐环流只是其中密度驱动的部分。

entries.definition: a circulation described by its up-and-down motion rather than its cause; it can be driven by heat, salt, wind or tides.
entries.definitionCN: 按上下运动而非按成因描述的环流；它可由热、盐、风或潮汐驱动。

entries.definition: the usual abbreviation of thermohaline circulation in tables and figures; it saves space, not meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 温盐环流在图表中的常用缩写；它省的是篇幅，不是含义。

entries.definition: the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation; it is the Atlantic part of the global loop, not the whole of it.
entries.definitionCN: 大西洋经向翻转环流；它是全球环路中的大西洋部分，而不是全部。

entries.definition: the teaching image of the loop, not a formal term; it stresses transport and underplays the return path.
entries.definitionCN: 环路的教学意象，不是正式术语；它强调输送，而对回程有所淡化。

entries.definition: the horizontal wind-driven loops within a basin; they lie above the overturning and are driven differently.
entries.definitionCN: 海盆内由风驱动的水平环路；它们位于翻转之上，成因也不同。

entries.definition: the process by which surface water becomes dense enough to sink; it is the start of the loop rather than the loop.
entries.definitionCN: 表层水变得足够重而下沉的过程；它是环路的起点，而不是环路本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Break it in two: thermohaline names the cause (heat and salt), circulation names the loop.
normal.cn: 拆成两半看：thermohaline 命名成因（热与盐），circulation 命名环路。

normal.en: circulation is from Latin circulus 'small ring': the water ends where it started, centuries later.
normal.cn: circulation 来自拉丁 circulus「小圆圈」：水在数百年后回到它出发的地方。

normal.en: Its parts are fixed: sinking limb, returning limb, deep water formation.
normal.cn: 它的部件是固定的：下沉支、回流支、深层水形成。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: weakening of thermohaline circulation, thermohaline circulation shutdown, thermohaline circulation model.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：温盐环流减弱、温盐环流停止、温盐环流模式。

normal.en: The abbreviation THC is the same thing in less space; AMOC is only its Atlantic branch.
normal.cn: 缩写 THC 是同一事物的简短写法；AMOC 只是它的大西洋分支。

abstract.en: Picture a loop drawn on a map that no ship could finish in a human lifetime.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上画着一个环路，没有船能在人的一生中走完。

abstract.en: Picture a belt with stations, turning so slowly that the movement is invisible.
abstract.cn: 想象一条带站点的传送带，慢到看不出它在动。

abstract.en: Picture cold salty water at the rim of the world, deciding to go down.
abstract.cn: 想象世界边缘又冷又咸的水，决定下沉。

examples.en: Thermohaline circulation is driven by density, not by wind.
examples.cn: 温盐环流由密度驱动，而不是由风驱动。

examples.en: A shutdown of thermohaline circulation would change climates far from the Atlantic.
examples.cn: 温盐环流一旦停止，远离大西洋的气候也会改变。

examples.en: Scientists compare model thermohaline circulation with traces left in sediments.
examples.cn: 科学家把模式中的温盐环流与沉积物里留下的痕迹作比较。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「热·盐·转圈」——热与盐让水变重下沉，绕地球转一大圈 → 温盐环流

root: thermohaline（希腊 thermē「热」+ halinos「盐的」+ 后缀 -ine）+ circulation（拉丁 circulus「小圆圈」→ circulatio「绕圈运转」，经古法语进入英语）；20 世纪海洋学复合术语，指密度驱动的全球翻转环流；拉丁 circulus 的印欧来源为重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one loop: the whole circuit, the cold place where it sinks, the long way back, the belt drawn in textbooks, the heat it carries, the carbon it buries, the cell in a model, the state read from the past, and the centuries it takes.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一个环路：整个循环、它下沉的寒冷起点、漫长的回程、教科书里画的传送带、它输送的热量、它封存的碳、模式中的单元、从过去读出的状态，以及它所花费的世纪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cold salty water sinking at the rim of the world and crawling back along the sea floor to rise elsewhere.
core.cn: 核心意象：世界边缘又冷又咸的水下沉，沿洋底爬行，再在别处升回海面。

branches.en: THE LOOP AND ITS START: the whole circuit, then the cold place where the descending limb begins.
branches.cn: 环路与起点：先是整个循环，然后是下沉支开始的寒冷海域。

branches.en: THE LONG WAY BACK: the return limb is why the whole loop is measured in centuries.
branches.cn: 漫长的回程：正是回流支决定了整个环路要以世纪来度量。

branches.en: PICTURE AND PIPES: a belt in the textbook, and a heating system in the climate.
branches.cn: 图像与管道：教科书里是传送带，气候系统里是供暖装置。

branches.en: WHAT IT CARRIES AND HOW IT IS MODELLED: carbon in the deep, and a single cell in a model.
branches.cn: 它载着什么、如何被模拟：深海中的碳，以及模式里的单个单元。

branches.en: READ IN MUD: past states of the loop reconstructed from sediment and ice.
branches.cn: 从泥里读出：由沉积物与冰重建出的环路过往状态。

intro.en: Thermohaline circulation is a two-word technical compound: one part built from Greek roots, one from a Latin root, and both recurrent in oceanography.
intro.cn: thermohaline circulation 是双词技术复合语：一部分由希腊词根构成，另一部分由拉丁词根构成，两者在海洋学中都反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin circulus and circulatio supply the second word and its family: circle, circular, circulate and circuit all return to the same ring.

definition_zh: 潮汐；潮水；潮流、趋势；（古）时节
definition_en: the regular rise and fall of the sea caused by the pull of the moon and sun; also a strong tendency in opinion or events
core_image: 海水沿着岸线按钟点涨上来又退下去，礁石先被淹没，随后又露出来
scene: 渔港清晨，老渔民看着石阶上的水痕往上爬说，The tide will turn before noon, so we should leave now.
sceneCN: 这里 tide 指「海面按月亮与太阳的引力规律涨落的现象」（第 1 个义项：潮汐）；句意为：潮水在正午前就会转向，我们该走了。

帮助渡过（难关）（多用于短语动词）
