senses.title: The sea's regular rise and fall
senses.definition: the regular rise and fall of the sea caused by the gravitational pull of the moon and sun
senses.definitionCN: 由月亮与太阳引力引起的海面规律性涨落
senses.example: The tide is strongest when moon and sun pull together.
senses.exampleCN: 日月引力同向时潮汐最强。
senses.why: Old English tīd meant 'time, fixed hour'; the sea's rise had its own hours, so the word for appointed time became the word for the water's appointment.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 tīd 意为「时间、固定时辰」；海水的涨落自有其时辰，于是指「约定时刻」的词变成了指海水赴约的词。

senses.title: High water
senses.definition: the state or point at which the sea has risen to its highest level
senses.definitionCN: 海水涨到最高水位时的状态或时刻
senses.example: At high tide the rocks are covered.
senses.exampleCN: 满潮时礁石被淹没。
senses.why: if the tide is the appointment, the top of it is the appointed fullness, and English names that state high tide.
senses.whyCN: 若 tide 是那个约定，它的顶点就是约定中的「满」，英语把这一状态称为 high tide。

senses.title: Low water
senses.definition: the state or point at which the sea has fallen to its lowest level
senses.definitionCN: 海水退到最低水位时的状态或时刻
senses.example: At low tide the harbour mouth is too shallow for the ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 低潮时港口入口太浅，渡轮进不来。
senses.why: the same appointment has a bottom, so the word covers both ends of the swing and the context picks the end.
senses.whyCN: 同一次赴约也有底点，因此这个词涵盖摆动的两端，由上下文决定指哪一端。

senses.title: The water itself
senses.definition: the water that moves in with the flood or out with the ebb, thought of as a mass rather than a schedule
senses.definitionCN: 随涨潮涌入或随退潮退去的水，被当作一团水而非时刻表
senses.example: The tide came over the wall and flooded the lane.
senses.exampleCN: 潮水越过矮墙淹没了小巷。
senses.why: once the word named the event, it could name the water that performs it, which is why a walker can be cut off by the tide.
senses.whyCN: 这个词一旦命名了事件，就能命名执行这件事的水，因此散步的人会被潮水围困。

senses.title: The drift of opinion
senses.definition: a strong tendency in opinion or events that seems to carry people along with it
senses.definitionCN: 舆论或事件中强劲的走向，仿佛带着人一起走
senses.example: The tide of opinion turned against the war.
senses.exampleCN: 舆论的潮流转而反对这场战争。
senses.why: a rising sea lifts everything in its path without asking, and a widespread change of mind feels exactly like that.
senses.whyCN: 上涨的海水不问情由地托起沿途一切，而人心的大范围转变感觉正是如此。

senses.title: One rise and fall
senses.definition: a single occurrence of the rise and fall, countable, as in the evening tide
senses.definitionCN: 涨落的一次完整发生，可数，如晚潮
senses.example: Two tides fill and empty the bay every day.
senses.exampleCN: 海湾每天被潮水灌满又放空两次。
senses.why: an appointment can be counted the way appointments are counted, so the mass-like word also takes a plural.
senses.whyCN: 约定可以像约会一样计数，因此这个看似不可数的词也有复数。

senses.title: A season or period, in older English
senses.definition: a period or season of time, surviving chiefly in compounds such as eventide and Yuletide
senses.definitionCN: 一段时间或节令，主要存于「黄昏」「圣诞时节」等复合词中
senses.example: The old carol speaks of the winter tide.
senses.exampleCN: 那首古老颂歌说到冬季时节。
senses.why: this is the original sense, kept in a handful of compounds after the sea sense took over the plain word.
senses.whyCN: 这是本义，在海义占据了这个光秃秃的词之后，它只留在少数复合词里。

senses.title: Tide as a modifier
senses.definition: used before another noun to mean belonging to or produced by the tide
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，表示属于潮汐或由潮汐造成的
senses.example: The tide table gives the hour of high water for every port.
senses.exampleCN: 潮汐表给出各港口满潮的时刻。
senses.why: a noun placed before another noun names a class, so tide stops meaning the event and starts labelling tables, pools and marks.
senses.whyCN: 名词放在另一名词前时命名一个类别，于是 tide 不再指那次事件，而开始标注表格、水潭与水痕。

senses.title: To carry someone through
senses.definition: in the phrase tide over, to carry a person or period through a difficulty until better conditions arrive
senses.definitionCN: 在表示「帮助渡过」的短语中，指帮人或帮一段时间撑过困难直到情况好转
senses.example: The loan tided them over until the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔贷款帮他们撑到了收获季节。
senses.why: the phrase is generally explained through the image of a rising tide carrying a boat over a shallow bar; a link with the older verb meaning 'to befall' is also proposed, and the two explanations coexist.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语一般都用水涨时把船托过浅滩的意象来解释；另有说法把它与意为「降临、发生」的古动词联系起来，两种解释并存，未定一尊。

intro.en: Tide is a native English word, not a borrowing: Old English tīd 'time, period, hour' narrowed to the sea's rise and fall in nautical use. It is cognate with German Zeit and Dutch tijd, none of which mean tide. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: tide 是英语本族词，不是外来借词：古英语 tīd「时间、时段、时辰」在航海用法中窄化为海水的涨落。它与德语 Zeit、荷兰语 tijd 同源，而那些词都不指潮汐。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tīd meant 'time, a space of time, a fixed hour'; it could name a season, a festival or the hour of an event, and had nothing to do with water.
items.cn: tīd 意为「时间、一段时间、固定时辰」；它能指节令、节日或某事的时刻，与海水毫无关系。

items.en: The same word appears as Old Norse tíð, Dutch tijd and German Zeit, all meaning time; the common Germanic form is reconstructed as *tīdiz.
items.cn: 同一个词也见于古诺斯语 tíð、荷兰语 tijd 与德语 Zeit，均指时间；其共同日耳曼语形式一般重构为 *tīdiz。

items.en: In nautical use from the later Middle Ages, tide came to mean the fixed hour of high water and then the rising water itself, while the general sense of time retreated into compounds.
items.cn: 中古后期以降，tide 在航海用法中先指满潮的固定时刻，再指上涨的水本身，而泛指时间的意思则退入复合词中。

items.en: Once the word belonged to the sea, it named the whole twice-daily cycle, and the plural tides let sailors and pilots count the cycles.
items.cn: 这个词一旦归海水所有，就命名整个每日两次的循环；复数 tides 让水手与引航员得以计数这些循环。

items.en: From the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the image of a rising sea was applied to opinion and events, giving the tide of opinion and to turn the tide.
items.cn: 16、17 世纪起，上涨之海的意象被用于舆论与事件，于是有「舆论的潮流」与「扭转潮流」这类说法。

items.en: Source uncertain (root only, not first date): the Indo-European source behind Germanic *tīdiz is generally reconstructed as a root meaning 'to divide', but the exact form differs between scholars and remains a reconstruction; the date of the nautical narrowing is only approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（指词根，不涉及首见年代）：日耳曼语 *tīdiz 背后的印欧来源一般重构为意为「划分」的词根，但具体形式各家不同，仍属重构；航海义窄化的年代也只有约数。

note.en: Group one holds a derivative, a same-root word that drifted in meaning, two compounds, and a word that merely looks alike; group two holds other names for the sea's movement, including the word from this batch that is most often confused with it.
note.cn: 第一组包括一个派生词、一个同根而语义漂移的词、两个复合词，以及一个只是形近的词；第二组是海面运动的其他名称，其中有本批最易与它混淆的词。

entries.definition: tide plus -al: relating to or affected by the tide; the adjective never means 'of time'.
entries.definitionCN: tide 加 -al：与潮汐有关的或受潮汐影响的；这个形容词从不表示「时间的」。

entries.definition: generally taken as tide 'season' plus -y, 'seasonable, timely', which then drifted to 'neat, in good order'; no water remains in it.
entries.definitionCN: 一般认为由 tide「时节」加 -y 构成，意为「合时令的、及时的」，后漂移为「整齐的、有条理的」；词中已不剩水义。

entries.definition: tide plus way: the channel through which a tidal stream runs, so it names a route rather than the water's rise.
entries.definitionCN: tide 加 way：潮流通过的水道，因此命名的是路线，而不是水位的上升。

entries.definition: the past tense of tie, from Old English tīgan 'to bind'; it sounds exactly like tide but has no connection with time or the sea.
entries.definitionCN: tie 的过去式，来自古英语 tīgan「捆绑」；它与 tide 读音完全相同，却与时间或海毫无关系。

entries.definition: a flow of water in one direction; it can be caused by the tide, but the current itself does not reverse on a schedule.
entries.definitionCN: 朝一个方向流动的水；它可以由潮汐引起，但水流本身不会按时刻表反向。

entries.definition: the outgoing tide, or the period when the sea falls; it names one half of the cycle, not the cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 退去的潮水，或海水下降的那段时间；它命名循环的一半，而不是循环本身。

entries.definition: the incoming tide, or the period when the sea rises; the flood tide is the mirror image of the ebb.
entries.definitionCN: 涌来的潮水，或海水上涨的那段时间；涨潮正是退潮的镜像。

entries.definition: a tidal bore: a wave that travels up a river with the incoming tide; it is one dramatic instance of a tide, not the general word.
entries.definitionCN: 涌潮：随涨潮沿河上溯的一道水墙；它是潮汐的一种激烈表现，而不是通称。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Old English tīd 'time': the tide is the sea keeping an appointment.
normal.cn: 古英语 tīd「时间」：潮汐就是海在赴约。

normal.en: Cognates prove the point: German Zeit, Dutch tijd and Old Norse tíð all mean time, never tide.
normal.cn: 同源词正好证明这一点：德语 Zeit、荷兰语 tijd、古诺斯语 tíð 都指时间，从不指潮。

normal.en: The family runs tidal, tidally, tideland, tideway, tidewater.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tidal、tidally、tideland、tideway、tidewater。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the physical sense: high tide, low tide, spring tide, neap tide, tide table.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出物理义：高潮、低潮、大潮、小潮、潮汐表。

normal.en: Tied is the look-alike trap: it is the past of tie, with no water in it.
normal.cn: tied 是形近陷阱：它是 tie 的过去式，里面没有水。

abstract.en: Picture a clock with no hands, only water.
abstract.cn: 想象一只没有指针、只有水的钟。

abstract.en: Picture a beach that is twice a day a different width.
abstract.cn: 想象一片海滩，每天两次变成不同的宽度。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd all moving the same way without anyone deciding it.
abstract.cn: 想象人群全朝同一个方向移动，却没有谁做决定。

examples.en: The tide in the bay rises and falls by several metres.
examples.cn: 海湾的潮水涨落达数米。

examples.en: Fishermen time their work by the tide rather than by the clock.
examples.cn: 渔民按潮汐而不是按钟表安排劳作。

examples.en: The tide of public opinion shifted after the report.
examples.cn: 报告发布后，舆论的潮流发生了变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬的」——月亮把海水抬起来又放下去，一抬一落就是潮 → 潮汐；潮流

root: 古英语 tīd「时间、时段、时辰」→ 中古英语 tide 在航海语境窄化为「潮时、潮水」；与德语 Zeit、荷兰语 tijd、古诺斯语 tíð 同源，共同日耳曼语形式重构为 *tīdiz；更早的印欧词根一般重构为 *dī-「划分」，属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one appointment: the regular event, its top and its bottom, the water that performs it, the borrowed image of opinion, a single countable cycle, the old sense of season, the noun used as a label, and the verb that carries someone through.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项跟着同一次赴约：规律的事件、它的顶点与底点、执行这件事的水、被借去指舆论的意象、一次可数的循环、指节令的古义、作标签用的名词，以及帮人撑过去的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the sea keeping an appointment, rising to a mark on the rock and falling away again.
core.cn: 核心意象：海在赴约，涨到岩石上的某道刻痕，又退下去。

branches.en: THE APPOINTMENT AND ITS TOP: the regular event, then the highest point it reaches.
branches.cn: 赴约与顶点：先是规律的事件，然后是它到达的最高处。

branches.en: THE OTHER END AND THE WATER: the lowest point, and the moving mass that produces it.
branches.cn: 另一端与水：最低处，以及造成这一切的那团流动的水。

branches.en: COUNTED AND BORROWED: one rise and fall, and the same image lent to opinion.
branches.cn: 可数与可借：一次涨落，以及借给舆论的同一意象。

branches.en: OLD TIME: the original sense of season, kept alive in a few compounds.
branches.cn: 古老的时间：指节令的本义，只活在少数复合词中。

branches.en: AS A LABEL AND AS A VERB: tide tables name a class, and tide over carries someone through.
branches.cn: 作标签与作动词：潮汐表命名一类东西，tide over 则把人送过难关。

intro.en: Tide is a native word, so its affixes are English: the adjective ending -al and the compounds built with land, way, water and table.
intro.cn: tide 是本族词，因此它的词缀都是英语的：形容词词尾 -al，以及与 land、way、water、table 构成的复合词。

latinIntro.en: Tide has no Latin family; Latin words for the sea's movement, such as aestus, are unrelated borrowings of a different root.
latinIntro.cn: tide 没有拉丁同族；拉丁语指海水运动的词如 aestus，是另一词根的词，与它并无亲缘。

items.structure: tīd (Old English noun, time, hour, season)
items.example: Tīd could name a festival as well as an hour.
items.exampleCN: tīd 既能指节庆，也能指时辰。

items.meaning: the sea's rise and fall; also a period
items.meaningCN: 海水的涨落；亦指一段时期
items.example: The tide turned before noon.
items.exampleCN: 潮水在正午前转向了。

items.example: Eventide and Yuletide keep the old sense alive.
items.exampleCN: eventide 与 Yuletide 让这一古义留存。

items.meaning: of or produced by the tide
items.example: A tidal river rises twice a day.
items.exampleCN: 有潮河每天上涨两次。

items.example: The basin is tidally flushed each day.
items.exampleCN: 这个海盆每天被潮汐冲洗。

items.meaning: land covered and uncovered by the tide
items.meaningCN: 被潮水淹没又露出的土地
items.example: Tideland is protected as nursery habitat.
items.exampleCN: 潮间地被当作育幼生境加以保护。

items.meaning: the channel of a tidal stream
items.example: The ferry follows the tideway into the harbour.
items.exampleCN: 渡轮顺着潮流通道进入港口。

items.meaning: water affected by the tide; a tidal river
items.meaningCN: 受潮汐影响的水；有潮河段
items.example: Tidewater reaches far upstream in dry weather.
items.exampleCN: 干旱时潮水能上溯很远。

items.meaning: a printed list of high and low water times
items.meaningCN: 印有高低潮时刻的表格
items.example: The tide table is printed for every port.
items.exampleCN: 潮汐表按每个港口印制。

items.meaning: to carry someone through a difficult period
items.meaningCN: 帮人撑过一段困难时期
items.example: Savings tided the family over the winter.
items.exampleCN: 积蓄帮这家人撑过了冬天。

definition_zh: 潮汐的；与潮汐有关的；受潮水涨落支配的
definition_en: relating to the tide, the regular rise and fall of sea level caused by the gravitational pull of the moon and the sun
core_image: 海水沿着同一道岸坡一天两次爬上来，又顺着同一个坡退回去，像有人在极慢地呼吸
scene: 沿海公路旁，测量员把潮汐表摊在引擎盖上，对照岸边的刻度说，Records of tidal water levels from this bay go back two centuries.
sceneCN: 这里 tidal 指「与潮汐这一自然现象有关的」（第 1 个义项：潮汐的、潮汐观测的）；句意为：这个海湾的潮位记录可以追溯到两百年前。

pos.zh: 潮汐的；与潮汐有关的
受潮水涨落支配的；随潮汐节律的（多作定语，比较级罕用）

forms.label: 比较级（关系形容词，罕用）
最高级（关系形容词，罕用）

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词后缀构成：以潮汐的方式；随潮汐节律地
由「潮」加「陆地」构成的复合词：受潮水淹没的滩地
由「潮」加「线」构成的复合词：高潮退去后留下的杂物线、潮线
由「潮」加「水」构成的复合词：受潮水推动的水；潮水灌溉的低地
由「潮」加「闸门」构成的复合词：挡潮闸，退潮时放水、涨潮时挡住海水

senses.title: Of the tide as a phenomenon
senses.definition: relating to the tide as a physical phenomenon, including its timing, its height and the study of it
senses.definitionCN: 与潮汐这一物理现象有关的，包括其时刻、高度以及相关研究
senses.example: Records of tidal water levels from this bay go back two centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这个海湾的潮位记录可以追溯到两百年前。
senses.why: tide began as a word for 'time', and -al means 'of or belonging to'; tidal therefore says 'of the tide' before it narrows to any particular place.
senses.whyCN: tide 最初是「时间」之词，-al 表示「属于……的」；因此 tidal 首先只是「潮汐的」，之后才收窄到具体场合。

senses.title: A place the tide governs
senses.definition: of a harbour, bay or stretch of shore that is open to the tide and whose water level changes with it
senses.definitionCN: 指敞开迎潮、水位随潮水升降的港口、海湾或河岸
senses.example: The harbour is tidal, so boats leave before the water drops.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口受潮水支配，所以船只要在水位退下前离港。
senses.why: a place described by what controls it takes the relational adjective; a tidal harbour is one where the tide, not the harbour, sets the water level.
senses.whyCN: 用支配它的力量来描写一个地点时就用这个关系形容词；受潮港口的意思是潮水而非港口本身决定水位。

senses.title: Driven by the tide
senses.definition: using the rise and fall of the tide as a source of motion or electric power
senses.definitionCN: 把潮水的涨落当作动力或电力来源的
senses.example: A tidal scheme could light the island twice a day.
senses.exampleCN: 一套潮汐发电方案能一天两次为这座岛供电。
senses.why: the adjective of origin also marks the source of power: what belongs to the tide can be turned into what runs on the tide.
senses.whyCN: 这个表示来源的形容词也能标出动力来源：属于潮汐的东西，可以被改造成靠潮汐运转的东西。

senses.title: Of the intertidal strip
senses.definition: of the zone between the high and low water marks, covered at high tide and bare at low tide
senses.definitionCN: 指高水位线与低水位线之间、涨潮被淹、退潮露出的地带
senses.example: Crabs wait out the low water in tidal pools.
senses.exampleCN: 螃蟹在潮池里熬过退潮的那段时间。
senses.why: that strip has no everyday name of its own, so the adjective does the work: it is the part of the shore the tide owns.
senses.whyCN: 那条地带在日常生活里没有专门名称，于是由形容词承担：它是岸上归潮水所有的那一段。

senses.title: Reversing with the tide
senses.definition: of a current or stream whose direction turns with the flood and the ebb
senses.definitionCN: 指方向随涨潮与退潮而反转的水流
senses.example: Pilots time their entry to a favourable tidal stream.
senses.exampleCN: 引航员会掐着顺向的潮流水势进港。
senses.why: a stream that turns is 'of the tide' in direction as well as in schedule, and the adjective covers both at once.
senses.whyCN: 会掉头的水流在方向上和时间上都「属于潮汐」，一个形容词同时覆盖这两层。

senses.title: Keeping tidal time
senses.definition: of a rhythm in a living thing that is set by the tide rather than by daylight
senses.definitionCN: 指生物体内由潮汐而非日照设定的节律
senses.example: Shorebirds feed on a tidal clock rather than on the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 滨鸟按潮汐的钟点觅食，而不是按太阳的钟点。
senses.why: biology needed a word for clocks the moon winds, and the existing adjective supplied it without any new coinage.
senses.whyCN: 生物学需要为「月亮上弦的钟」找一个词，现成的形容词直接顶上，不必再造新词。

senses.title: Reached by the tide upstream
senses.definition: of the lower course of a river that salt water enters and pushes back twice a day
senses.definitionCN: 指海水每天两次灌入并顶托的河流下游段
senses.example: The lower river is tidal as far as the weir.
senses.exampleCN: 这条河的下游一直到拦河堰都是感潮的。
senses.why: the tide does not stop at the coast; where it forces its way up a river, that reach becomes literally of the tide.
senses.whyCN: 潮水并不止于海岸；它顶进河流的那一段，字面上就成了「潮汐的」地盘。

senses.title: Of a gravitational tide
senses.definition: of the bulge or force raised in one body by another body's gravity, with or without water
senses.definitionCN: 指一个天体被另一个天体的引力拉出的隆起或作用力，无论表面有没有水
senses.example: The moon lifts a tidal bulge in the solid rock.
senses.exampleCN: 月球在坚硬的岩层里也拉起一个潮汐隆起。
senses.why: physics kept the water image and moved it to rock: what the moon raises in the earth is of the same nature as the sea's tide.
senses.whyCN: 物理学保留水的意象又把它挪到岩石上：月球在地球里拉出的隆起，与海潮在性质上相同。

senses.title: Of one breath's volume
senses.definition: of the volume of air moved in or out in a single ordinary breath
senses.definitionCN: 指一次平静呼吸进出肺部的空气体积
senses.example: The nurse recorded the patient's tidal volume every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 护士每小时记录一次病人的潮气量。
senses.why: breathing repeats like the water's rise and fall, so respiratory physiology borrowed the adjective for the air moved in one cycle.
senses.whyCN: 呼吸像水的涨落一样往复，呼吸生理学于是借这个形容词，指一个周期里进出的空气量。

intro.en: Tidal is a native Germanic noun fitted with a borrowed suffix: Old English tīd 'time' became tide, and English added -al to make an adjective from it. The word is recorded in tide-related writing from the eighteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: tidal 是一个日耳曼本族名词加外来后缀的构造：古英语 tīd「时间」演变为 tide，英语再加 -al 构成形容词。这个词从 18 世纪的潮汐类写作中开始见于书证，年代均为约数。

items.en: Tīd meant 'time, hour, season, appointed time' and survives in eventide and Yuletide; the Germanic noun behind it is reconstructed as *tīdiz, the same word as German Zeit, so the sea sense grew out of the fixed hours at which high water was expected.
items.cn: tīd 意为「时间、时辰、季节、约定的时刻」，今仍存于若干表示时令的旧词中；其背后的日耳曼名词重构为 *tīdiz，与德语 Zeit 同词，海潮义正是从「高潮到来的固定时刻」长出来的。

items.en: By the fourteenth century tide named the rise and fall of the sea itself, and high tide and low tide had become fixed phrases.
items.cn: 到 14 世纪，tide 已指海水本身的涨落，「高潮」与「低潮」成为固定说法。

items.en: The adjective suffix -al goes back to Latin -alis by way of Norman French; English attaches it freely to nouns (tidal, coastal, legal) to mean 'of or belonging to'.
items.cn: 形容词后缀 -al 经诺曼法语上溯到拉丁 -alis；英语把它自由地加在名词后，表示「属于……的」。

items.en: Tidal appears in eighteenth-century writing on harbours and tide tables, where an adjective was needed for the phenomenon itself rather than for a particular tide.
items.cn: tidal 见于 18 世纪关于港口与潮汐表的写作，当时需要一个形容词来指这一现象本身，而不是某一次具体的潮。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the adjective spread to tidal power, tidal force in astronomy and tidal volume in physiology, each time keeping the core relation 'of the tide'.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪，这个形容词扩展到潮汐发电、天文学中的引潮力、生理学中的潮气量，每次都保留「属于潮汐」这一核心关系。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only, not root): the earliest citation of tidal is generally placed in the eighteenth century but is not precisely dated; *tīdiz is a reconstruction, while the cognacy of tide and German Zeit is not in doubt.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代，不涉及词根）：tidal 的最早书证一般定在 18 世纪，但没有确切年份；*tīdiz 是重构形式，而 tide 与德语 Zeit 同源这一点并无争议。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like tidal or are built on the same stem, including two that end alike but come from different roots; group two holds words used about the same coastal setting.
note.cn: 第一组是与 tidal 形近或同出同一词干的词，其中两个结尾相同但词根不同；第二组是用于同一海岸情境的词。

entries.definition: the rise and fall of the sea itself; tidal only describes what belongs to it, so the noun cannot stand in for the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 海水本身的涨落；tidal 只描写属于它的东西，因此这个名词不能替代形容词。

entries.definition: tidal plus -ly, describing how something is done or driven, as in a tidally flushed lagoon.
entries.definitionCN: tidal 加 -ly，描写某事以何种方式发生或被驱动，如「靠潮水冲刷的潟湖」。

entries.definition: from Latin titulus 'inscription, label'; the shared ending is accidental and there is no tide in it.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 titulus「铭文、标签」；相同的词尾纯属巧合，与潮汐无关。

entries.definition: from bride plus -al, meaning 'of a wedding'; it rhymes with tidal but is built on a different noun.
entries.definitionCN: 由「新娘」一词加 -al 构成，意为「婚礼的」；它与 tidal 押韵，却建立在另一个名词上。

entries.definition: between the high and low water marks; it names one zone, while tidal can qualify anything connected with the tide.
entries.definitionCN: 位于高低潮线之间；它只指一个地带，而 tidal 可修饰任何与潮汐有关的事物。

entries.definition: of the shore, whether or not tides reach it; it is a wider term than tidal.
entries.definitionCN: 海岸的，无论潮水是否到达；它比 tidal 范围更宽。

entries.definition: of an estuary, the place where a river meets the tide; it names the setting rather than the tide's influence.
entries.definitionCN: 河口湾的，即河流与潮水相遇之处；它指这类地点，而非潮汐的影响。

entries.definition: recurring at regular intervals; tidal behaviour is one kind of periodic behaviour, so the general word is wider.
entries.definitionCN: 按固定间隔重复的；潮汐行为是周期性行为的一种，因此这个一般词的范围更宽。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Old English tīd meant 'time', and the tide keeps its own clock: high water arrives at fixed hours.
normal.cn: 古英语 tīd 意为「时间」，潮水也自带时钟：高潮总在固定的时刻到来。

normal.en: The family runs tide, tidal, tidally, tideland, tideline, tidewater, tidegate.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tide、tidal、tidally、tideland、tideline、tidewater、tidegate。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the coastal sense: tidal flat, tidal pool, tidal current, tidal bore.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出海岸义：潮滩、潮池、潮流、涌潮。

normal.en: German Zeit 'time' is the cousin of tide; the two words split long before English existed.
normal.cn: 德语 Zeit「时间」是 tide 的表亲，两词在英语形成之前就已分开。

normal.en: A relational adjective rarely takes more or most: the comparative sounds awkward in ordinary use.
normal.cn: 关系形容词很少用比较级：在普通用法里，比较级听起来很别扭。

abstract.en: Picture the sea climbing a stone stair, one step every six hours.
abstract.cn: 想象海水在爬石阶，每六个小时上一级。

abstract.en: Picture a clock whose hands are moved by the moon instead of by a spring.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟，指针不靠发条，而由月亮推动。

abstract.en: Picture a river that briefly turns salty and flows backwards twice a day.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河一天两次短暂变咸，并倒着流。

examples.en: Tidal water reached the lower streets before dawn.
examples.cn: 天亮前，潮水已经漫到低处的街道。

examples.en: The tidal flat teems with worms and shells at low water.
examples.cn: 退潮时，潮滩上尽是沙蚕与贝壳。

examples.en: Engineers survey tidal currents before anchoring the turbine.
examples.cn: 工程师在固定涡轮之前先勘测潮流。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬陡」——潮水抬得又陡又快，一转眼漫上滩面 → 潮汐的、受潮水支配的

root: 古英语 tīd「时间、时辰」（日耳曼语重构 *tīdiz，与德语 Zeit 同源）→ 中古英语 tide 兼指海水的定时涨落 → tide + 形容词后缀 -al → tidal；*tīdiz 属构拟形式。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses all keep one relation, 'of the tide': the phenomenon and its records, the places it governs, the power drawn from it, the strip it owns, the currents it turns, the clocks it winds, the rivers it pushes up, the rock it bulges, and finally the breath it resembles.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都守着同一个关系「属于潮汐」：现象及其记录、受它支配的地点、从它取用的动力、它拥有的地带、它反转的水流、它上弦的钟、它顶进的河流、它拉起的岩层，最后是它所比拟的一次呼吸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the sea climbing and retreating along the same shore twice a day, on a schedule set by the moon.
core.cn: 核心意象：海水沿着同一道岸坡一天涨落两次，时刻由月亮定下。

branches.en: THE BASIC RELATION: first the phenomenon and its records, then the places and waters it governs.
branches.cn: 基本关系：先是现象及其记录，然后是受它支配的地点与水域。

branches.en: TIDE AS FORCE: the water that spins a turbine is the same water that reverses a channel.
branches.cn: 潮汐作为力：转动涡轮的水，与让水道掉头的水是同一股。

branches.en: THE STRIP THE TIDE OWNS: between the marks, the tide decides what may live and when.
branches.cn: 潮水拥有的地带：在两条水位线之间，潮汐决定谁能生存、何时生存。

branches.en: TIDE AS CLOCK AND AS INTRUSION: organisms keep its rhythm, and rivers feel its push upstream.
branches.cn: 潮汐作为时钟与侵入者：生物守着它的节律，河流感到它向上游的顶托。

branches.en: THE IMAGE EXTENDED: gravity raises rock, and breathing repeats like water.
branches.cn: 意象的延伸：引力拉起岩石，呼吸像水一样往复。

intro.en: Tidal is a native Germanic noun with a borrowed suffix: tide comes from Old English, while -al reached English through Latin and French and then became fully productive.
intro.cn: tidal 是日耳曼本族名词加外来后缀：tide 来自古英语，而 -al 经拉丁语与法语进入英语，随后成为能产后缀。

latinIntro.en: Only the suffix is Latin (-alis); tide itself has no Latin cognate, since it descends from Germanic *tīdiz. The Latin entries are therefore empty by design, and Latin-based look-alikes such as title belong to other roots.
latinIntro.cn: 只有后缀是拉丁的（-alis）；tide 本身来自日耳曼 *tīdiz，没有拉丁同族词，因此拉丁条目按实情留空；像 title 这类拉丁系形近词属于别的词根。

items.example: High water came at the appointed tīd.
items.exampleCN: 高潮在约定的时辰到来。

items.example: The same suffix builds tidal from tide.
items.exampleCN: 同一个后缀把 tide 构成 tidal。

items.meaning: the rise and fall of the sea
items.example: The tide turned before noon.
items.exampleCN: 中午之前潮水转向了。

items.meaning: of or relating to the tide
items.example: Tidal water covered the road.
items.exampleCN: 潮水淹了这条路。

items.meaning: in a manner driven by the tide
items.example: The lagoon is flushed tidally.
items.exampleCN: 这片潟湖靠潮水冲刷。

items.example: Eelgrass grows on the tideland.
items.exampleCN: 大叶藻长在潮间地上。

items.meaning: the line of debris left by high water
items.meaningCN: 高潮退去后留下的杂物线
items.example: A tideline of plastic marked the beach.
items.exampleCN: 一道塑料垃圾的潮线划在海滩上。

items.meaning: water moved by the tide; low coastal land
items.meaningCN: 受潮水推动的水；沿海低地
items.example: Tidewater reaches the old mill pond.
items.exampleCN: 潮水能涨到那座旧磨坊的水塘。

items.meaning: a gate that keeps the tide out
items.example: The tidegate protects the low fields.
items.exampleCN: 挡潮闸保护低处的田地。

items.example: Intertidal rocks are bare at low water.
items.exampleCN: 退潮时潮间带的礁石裸露出来。

definition_zh: 潮差；高潮与低潮的水位差
definition_en: the vertical difference between the height of high water and the height of low water at a particular place
core_image: 一根水尺立在码头边，涨潮的刻痕与退潮的刻痕上下分开，两道痕之间的距离就是潮差
scene: 港口潮位站里，值班员对比今早与傍晚的水尺读数说，The tidal range here is over eight metres, among the largest in the world.
sceneCN: 这里 tidal range 指「同一地点高潮位与低潮位之间的垂直水位差」（第 1 个义项：潮差本身）；句意为：这里的潮差超过八米，是世界上最大的几处之一。

pos.zh: 潮差；高潮与低潮的水位差

derivatives.zh: 本短语的修饰成分，由「潮」加形容词后缀构成，18 世纪起用于潮汐写作
本短语的中心词，源自表示「一排、一行」的古法语词，语义由「排列」转为「两端之间的跨度」
由本短语的修饰成分加副词后缀构成：以潮汐的方式（修饰动词）

senses.title: The vertical difference itself
senses.definition: the vertical distance between the high-water mark and the low-water mark at one place, measured in metres or feet
senses.definitionCN: 同一地点高潮位标记与低潮位标记之间的垂直距离，以米或英尺计
senses.example: The tidal range here is over eight metres, among the largest in the world.
senses.exampleCN: 这里的潮差超过八米，是世界上最大的几处之一。
senses.why: range already meant the distance between two limits, so joining it to tidal produces the interval between the two water marks rather than a single water level.
senses.whyCN: range 本来就指两个界限之间的距离，接上 tidal 之后，得到的就是两道水位标记之间的间隔，而不是某一个水位。

senses.title: The printed figure for a port
senses.titleCN: 潮汐表上某个港口的潮差数值
senses.definition: the number listed for a named port in tide tables or nautical charts
senses.definitionCN: 潮汐表或海图上为某个具名港口列出的那个数值
senses.example: The chart prints the tidal range for every port on the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 海图上为沿岸每个港口都印出了潮差。
senses.why: a tide table needs one figure per place, and the phrase becomes the label on that printed line rather than the water it describes.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐表每个地点需要一个数，短语于是成了那一行印刷数字的标签，而不只是它所描述的水。

senses.title: The spring maximum
senses.definition: the enlarged difference at spring tides, when sun and moon pull in line
senses.definitionCN: 朔望时日月连成一线、引潮力叠加而形成的加大水位差
senses.example: Springs bring the largest tidal range of the month.
senses.exampleCN: 大潮带来一个月中最大的潮差。
senses.why: spring tides follow new and full moons, when the two pulls add, so the same measurement reaches its monthly maximum and needs its own qualifier.
senses.whyCN: 大潮出现在朔与望，两个引力相加，因此同一个量值达到月内最大，需要专门的限定语。

senses.title: The neap minimum
senses.definition: the reduced difference at neap tides, when the two pulls oppose each other
senses.definitionCN: 上下弦时日月引力相互抵消而形成的小幅水位差
senses.example: Neap tides give a tidal range barely half as large.
senses.exampleCN: 小潮的潮差大约只有一半。
senses.why: neap tides come when the sun and moon pull at right angles, so the range shrinks while the phrase keeps the same name with a smaller value.
senses.whyCN: 小潮出现在日月成直角相拉之时，潮差因而收缩，而短语仍用同一个名称，只是数值更小。

senses.title: The design average
senses.definition: the long-term mean difference used by engineers and pilots as a working datum
senses.definitionCN: 工程师与引航员作为工作基准使用的长期平均水位差
senses.example: Engineers size the sill from the mean tidal range.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师按平均潮差来确定门槛的高度。
senses.why: design needs an average rather than an extreme, so the phrase is qualified by mean and turns into a datum for construction.
senses.whyCN: 设计需要平均值而不是极值，短语因此加上「平均」这一限定，变成施工基准。

senses.title: The width of the bare shore
senses.titleCN: 潮差决定露出的滩面宽度
senses.definition: the horizontal extent of shore left bare at low water, as produced by the vertical range on a gentle beach
senses.definitionCN: 平缓海滩上由垂直潮差换算出的、退潮时露出的水平滩面宽度
senses.example: A wide tidal range bares a kilometre of mud at low water.
senses.exampleCN: 潮差大时，退潮会露出一公里宽的泥滩。
senses.why: the vertical difference maps onto horizontal distance because a gentle beach turns every metre of fall into many metres of shore.
senses.whyCN: 垂直差值会换算成水平距离，因为平缓海滩把每下降一米变成好几米的滩面。

senses.title: The head available for power
senses.definition: the water-level difference that a tidal power scheme can use to drive turbines
senses.definitionCN: 潮汐发电方案可用来驱动涡轮的水位差
senses.example: The plant's output rises with the tidal range.
senses.exampleCN: 这座电站的发电量随潮差增大而上升。
senses.why: a tidal plant runs on the head between high and low water, so the range stops being a description and becomes stored energy.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐电站靠高低潮之间的水头运转，潮差于是不再只是描述，而成了储存的能量。

senses.title: The effect of coastal shape
senses.titleCN: 海岸形状造成的潮差放大
senses.definition: the local value produced when the shape of a bay or funnel concentrates the incoming tide
senses.definitionCN: 海湾或漏斗形岸线汇聚涌来的潮水后形成的当地数值
senses.example: The funnel shape of the bay amplifies its tidal range.
senses.exampleCN: 海湾的漏斗形状放大了它的潮差。
senses.why: a narrowing funnel forces the same water into a smaller width, so the height grows and the local range becomes a signature of the coast's shape.
senses.whyCN: 收窄的漏斗把同样的水挤进更窄的宽度，高度因此增加，当地的潮差就成了岸形的签名。

senses.title: A record in sediment
senses.titleCN: 沉积层中记录的古代潮差
senses.definition: a past value reconstructed from old high-water deposits, used to trace sea-level change
senses.definitionCN: 从古代高潮沉积物中重建出的过往数值，用来追踪海平面变化
senses.example: Sediment layers record how the tidal range changed with sea level.
senses.exampleCN: 沉积层记录了潮差如何随海平面变化。
senses.why: mud keeps the position of old high-water marks, so the same interval can be measured in rock long after the water has gone.
senses.whyCN: 泥沙保存了古代高潮位的位置，因此水面早已退去之后，同一个间隔仍可在岩层中量出。

intro.en: Tidal range is a compound phrase, not a single derived word: tidal is tide plus -al, and range came into English from Old French range 'row, line'. The pair became a fixed term in nineteenth-century tide tables and charts. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: tidal range 是复合短语，不是单一派生词：tidal 是 tide 加 -al，range 则由古法语 range「一排、一行」进入英语。这一组合在 19 世纪的潮汐表与海图中固定为术语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tidal is tide plus the adjective suffix -al, formed when tide tables needed a word for the phenomenon itself rather than for one particular tide.
items.cn: tidal 是 tide 加形容词后缀 -al，形成于潮汐表需要一个指现象本身的词、而非某一次具体的潮之时。

items.en: Old French range meant 'row, line, rank', from the verb rangier 'to place in rows'; the noun first named things standing in a line.
items.cn: 古法语 range 意为「一排、一行、一列」，源自动词 rangier「排成行」；名词最初指排成一线的东西。

items.en: English took range in the fourteenth century; by the seventeenth it also meant the extent between two limits, as in a range of mountains or of prices.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪借入 range；到 17 世纪，它又指两个界限之间的跨度，如山脉的走向范围或价格区间。

items.en: In nineteenth-century tide tables and sailing directions the two words were joined for the difference between high and low water, because two marks on a staff define an interval.
items.cn: 19 世纪的潮汐表与航路指南把这两个词连用，指高低潮之间的差值，因为水尺上的两道刻痕恰好界定一个间隔。

items.en: Twentieth-century oceanography qualified the phrase as mean, spring or neap range, turning it into a standard variable in charts, engineering and tidal power.
items.cn: 20 世纪的海洋学给这个短语加上「平均」「大潮」「小潮」等限定，使它成为海图、工程与潮汐发电中的标准变量。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the exact first citation of the phrase is not fixed, though the nineteenth-century dating is generally accepted; the Frankish *hring 'ring' sometimes proposed behind Old French rang is a reconstruction, and the ultimate origin of range is disputed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：该短语的最早书证没有确切年份，19 世纪的说法属于「一般认为是」；有人为古法语 rang 构拟法兰克语 *hring「环」，这属于重构，range 的更早来源本身有争议。

note.en: Group one holds the phrase's own parts and the other English words built on the same range root; group two holds neighbouring measures that are often mistaken for the range.
note.cn: 第一组是本短语自身的构件，以及建立在同一 range 词根上的其他英语词；第二组是常被误当作潮差的邻近量值。

entries.definition: the first element by itself: it means 'of the tide' and says nothing about a difference between two levels.
entries.definitionCN: 第一个构件单独使用：意为「潮汐的」，完全不涉及两个水位之间的差值。

entries.definition: the head noun alone means extent or scope of any kind; only the full phrase fixes it to water levels.
entries.definitionCN: 中心词单独使用时泛指任何范围或幅度；只有完整短语才把它锁定在水位上。

entries.definition: a- plus range, literally 'put into rows'; it keeps the original idea of lining things up.
entries.definitionCN: a- 加 range，字面是「排成行」；它保留了最初「把东西排成一线」的意思。

entries.definition: de- 'away from' plus range, 'put out of rows', hence to disorder or disturb.
entries.definitionCN: de-「离开」加 range，「把行列打乱」，因此指使混乱、扰乱。

entries.definition: the height of the tide measured from mean water to high water, which is half the tidal range.
entries.definitionCN: 从平均水位量到高潮位的高度，正好是潮差的一半。

entries.definition: the height of the water above a chart datum at a given moment, not a difference between two levels.
entries.definitionCN: 某一时刻水面高出海图基准面的高度，而不是两个水位之间的差。

entries.definition: the reference level from which heights are measured, usually low water; it is a baseline, not a range.
entries.definitionCN: 测量高度的参考面，通常取低潮面；它是基准，不是潮差。

entries.definition: the horizontal distance a water particle travels between flood and ebb; it is the range turned sideways.
entries.definitionCN: 一个水质点在涨潮与退潮之间水平移动的距离；可说是把潮差横过来量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Two marks on a tide staff, one high and one low: range is the distance between two limits.
normal.cn: 水尺上两道刻痕，一高一低：range 就是两个界限之间的距离。

normal.en: The family runs tide, tidal, tidally, range, arrange, derange, ranger.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tide、tidal、tidally、range、arrange、derange、ranger。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the technical use: mean tidal range, spring tidal range, neap tidal range.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出技术用法：平均潮差、大潮潮差、小潮潮差。

normal.en: Amplitude is half the range, and tidal height is measured from a datum.
normal.cn: 振幅是潮差的一半，而潮高是从基准面量起的。

normal.en: A funnel-shaped bay concentrates the tide, so the same ocean produces a bigger range there.
normal.cn: 漏斗形海湾会汇聚潮水，同样的外海在那里造出更大的潮差。

abstract.en: Picture a stone marked twice a day by the sea, and the gap between the two wet lines.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头被海一天标记两次，两条湿痕之间那道空隙。

abstract.en: Picture a door that opens wider at the full moon and narrows at the quarter.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，满月时开得最宽，上下弦时收得最窄。

abstract.en: Picture a beach that doubles in width twice a day without moving an inch inland.
abstract.cn: 想象一片海滩一天两次宽度翻倍，海岸线却一寸也不向内陆移动。

examples.en: A tidal range of two metres shapes the whole beach.
examples.cn: 两米的潮差塑造了整片海滩。

examples.en: The bay's tidal range makes it a candidate for tidal power.
examples.cn: 这个海湾的潮差使它成为潮汐发电的候选地。

examples.en: Pilots check the tidal range before crossing the bar.
examples.cn: 引航员在越过拦门沙之前先查潮差。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬陡」加「范围」——潮水抬得陡，上下就拉出一个范围，这个范围就是潮差

root: tidal（古英语 tīd「时间、时辰」+ -al）+ range（古法语 range「一排、一行」，源自动词 rangier「排成行」，或出自法兰克语 *hring「环」的构拟）；19 世纪潮汐表与航路指南把两者连用，固定为「潮差」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow a single interval: the vertical gap itself, the figure printed for a port, its monthly maximum and minimum, the average engineers use, the shore it bares, the head it offers a turbine, the shape of coast that enlarges it, and the trace it leaves in sediment.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都围绕同一个间隔：垂直落差本身、为港口印出的数值、月内的最大值与最小值、工程师用的平均值、它露出的滩面、它给涡轮的水头、放大它的岸形，以及它在沉积层里留下的痕迹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two marks on one tide staff, one left by high water and one by low water, with the interval between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一根水尺上的两道刻痕，一道由高潮留下、一道由低潮留下，中间隔着一段距离。

branches.en: THE MEASURE ITSELF: first two marks on a staff, then the number printed for a named port.
branches.cn: 量值本身：先是水尺上的两道痕，然后是为某个港口印出的那个数。

branches.en: THE MONTHLY SWING: spring widens the interval, neap narrows it, and both keep the same name.
branches.cn: 月内的摆动：大潮把间隔拉大，小潮把它收紧，两者都沿用同一个名称。

branches.en: DESIGN AND POWER: the mean value sizes a sill, and the same head turns a turbine.
branches.cn: 设计与动力：平均值用来定门槛高度，同一个水头又推动涡轮。

branches.en: SHAPE OF THE COAST: a wide range bares a wide flat, and a funnel bay magnifies the range.
branches.cn: 海岸的形状：潮差大就露出宽滩，漏斗形海湾则把潮差放大。

branches.en: DEEP TIME: old high-water marks survive in mud, so the interval can be read in rock.
branches.cn: 深层时间：古代高潮位留在泥沙里，于是这个间隔可以在岩层中读出。

intro.en: This entry is a two-word phrase, so its parts are analysed separately: tidal is a Germanic root with a Latin-derived suffix, and range is a French borrowing with a Germanic reconstruction behind it.
intro.cn: 本条目是两个词的短语，因此把构件分开分析：tidal 是日耳曼词根加拉丁系后缀，range 则是法语借词，其背后还有一个日耳曼语的构拟形式。

latinIntro.en: Neither part has a Latin root: tide descends from Germanic *tīdiz, and range came through Old French from Frankish. Latin unda 'wave' and Latin latus 'wide' are unrelated words, so the Latin entries stay empty; only the suffix -alis is Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 两个构件都没有拉丁词根：tide 出自日耳曼 *tīdiz，range 则经古法语来自法兰克语。拉丁 unda「波浪」与 latus「宽」都是不相干的词，因此拉丁条目留空；只有后缀 -alis 属于拉丁。

items.example: The tide kept the hour of the moon.
items.exampleCN: 潮水守着月亮的时辰。

items.example: The same suffix builds tidal from tide.
items.exampleCN: 同一个后缀把 tide 构成 tidal。

items.example: Tidal water fills the harbour twice a day.
items.exampleCN: 潮水一天两次灌满港口。

items.meaning: row, line; later extent between limits
items.meaningCN: 一排、一行；后指界限之间的跨度
items.example: The range of prices surprised buyers.
items.exampleCN: 价格区间让买家吃惊。

items.structure: Old French rangier (verb, 'to place in rows')
items.example: Old French rangier meant to place things in rows.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 rangier 意为把东西排成行。

items.meaning: to put into rows, to order
items.example: Arrange the samples by salinity.
items.exampleCN: 按盐度排列这些样品。

items.example: The storm deranged the tide gauge.
items.exampleCN: 风暴把验潮仪打乱了。

items.meaning: a person who roams or guards a range
items.meaningCN: 巡行的人；管护一片区域的人
items.example: A ranger met us at the trailhead.
items.exampleCN: 一位巡护员在山道口接我们。

items.meaning: the interval between high and low water
items.meaningCN: 高低潮之间的水位间隔
items.example: The tidal range governs the harbour's schedule.
items.exampleCN: 潮差决定这个港口的时间表。

items.example: The basin is flushed tidally.
items.exampleCN: 这个水盆靠潮水冲刷。

definition_zh: 潮汐波；涌潮；（误用）海啸；浪潮般的大规模涌动
definition_en: a wave produced by the tide; loosely and often wrongly, a tsunami; also a great overwhelming surge of something
core_image: 一道水墙顺着河口逆流推上来，把整条河面抬高，后面拖着长长的白浪
scene: 海洋学课堂上，老师画出海湾的剖面说，The tide enters the bay as a slow tidal wave, not as a breaking wall.
sceneCN: 这里 tidal wave 指「潮汐本身传入海湾的长波」（第 1 个义项：由潮汐运动产生、波长极长的水波）；句意为：潮水是以一道缓慢的潮汐波进入海湾的，并非一堵破碎的水墙。

pos.zh: 潮汐波；涌潮；（误用）海啸
浪潮般的大规模涌动（情绪、人群、事件）

derivatives.zh: 本短语的修饰成分，由「潮」加形容词后缀构成，意为潮汐的
本短语的中心词，源自古英语表示「浪」的词，后又引申为挥手与物理波
由中心词加形容词后缀构成：波浪形的

senses.title: The long wave of the tide
senses.definition: the very long wave by which the tide propagates into an ocean, sea or bay, with a wavelength of hundreds of kilometres
senses.definitionCN: 潮汐借以传入大洋、海或海湾的极长水波，波长可达数百公里
senses.example: The tide enters the bay as a slow tidal wave, not as a breaking wall.
senses.exampleCN: 潮水是以一道缓慢的潮汐波进入海湾的，并非一堵破碎的水墙。
senses.why: the tide is not a current but a wave so long that its crest may span an ocean; older oceanography called that wave a tidal wave before the term drifted.
senses.whyCN: 潮汐不是一股水流，而是一道长得波峰可横跨大洋的波；较早的海洋学就把这道波叫作 tidal wave，后来这个词才漂移。

senses.title: The bore in an estuary
senses.definition: the steep front of the advancing tide in a narrow estuary, seen as a single wall of water moving upstream
senses.definitionCN: 窄河口里推进的潮水形成的陡立波前，看上去是一道向上游移动的水墙
senses.example: At the head of the estuary the tidal wave stood like a wall of water.
senses.exampleCN: 在河口顶端，那道潮波像一堵水墙立了起来。
senses.why: in a narrowing channel the tide's front steepens until it becomes one breaking step, and that visible step is what people first named a tidal wave.
senses.whyCN: 在收窄的河道里，潮水的前缘越来越陡，直到变成一级破碎的台阶，人们最初就是用 tidal wave 指这道看得见的台阶。

senses.title: Any huge wave, loosely
senses.definition: in casual speech, any exceptionally large wave, whatever its cause
senses.definitionCN: 日常口语里指任何特别大的浪，不问成因
senses.example: A tidal wave lifted the dinghy onto the pier.
senses.exampleCN: 一道巨浪把小艇托上了码头。
senses.why: a casual speaker notices size before cause, so an overwhelming wave inherits the label even when no tide is involved.
senses.whyCN: 随口说话的人先注意到大小、后追问成因，因此哪怕与潮汐无关，压过来的大浪也会被安上这个名称。

senses.title: The misnomer for a tsunami
senses.definition: a popular but inaccurate name for a tsunami, the sea wave generated by an earthquake, landslide or volcanic collapse
senses.definitionCN: 对海啸的通俗而不准确的称呼；海啸由地震、滑坡或火山崩塌引起
senses.example: The headline called the earthquake's tsunami a tidal wave, though no tide was involved.
senses.exampleCN: 标题把那场地震引发的海啸称作「潮汐波」，尽管根本没有潮汐参与。
senses.why: the phrase already meant 'a great wave coming in from the sea', so news language kept it after seismology supplied the accurate Japanese-derived word tsunami.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语本来就有「从海上压来的巨浪」之意，因此海洋学给出准确的日源词 tsunami 之后，新闻语言仍沿用旧说法。

senses.title: A surge of feeling
senses.definition: a sudden, overwhelming rush of emotion that seems to sweep a person or group away
senses.definitionCN: 突然涌来、仿佛把人或群体卷走的情感
senses.example: A tidal wave of relief swept through the crowd when the doors opened.
senses.exampleCN: 门一开，一阵如释重负的浪潮扫过人群。
senses.why: an emotion that arrives all at once and cannot be resisted is pictured as water that overwhelms the shore, so the sea phrase becomes a feeling phrase.
senses.whyCN: 一下子涌来、无法抵挡的情绪，会被想象成淹没岸线的水，于是海的短语变成了情感的短语。

senses.title: A surge of people
senses.definition: a very large number of people arriving or moving together faster than the place can absorb them
senses.definitionCN: 大批人一起到来或移动，速度超过当地所能承受的程度
senses.example: A tidal wave of migration changed the town within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 一股移民洪流在一年之内改变了这座小镇。
senses.why: large movements of people are counted like water: one continuous mass arriving faster than the shore can take it.
senses.whyCN: 人口的大规模移动被当作水来计量：一整团连续不断的来者，快到岸来不及承接。

senses.title: A surge of messages or events
senses.titleCN: 投诉、消息等事件的洪流
senses.definition: a sudden mass of complaints, requests or news arriving at one time
senses.definitionCN: 投诉、请求或消息在同一时间大量涌来
senses.example: A tidal wave of complaints followed the new timetable.
senses.exampleCN: 新时刻表一公布，投诉便如潮水般涌来。
senses.why: the metaphor counts separate items as one mass, which is exactly how a flood of identical messages feels to the person receiving it.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把一件件分开的东西算作一整团，而这正是收件人面对成堆同样消息时的感受。

senses.title: A landslide in politics
senses.definition: a sweeping electoral victory that carries a party past its opponents everywhere at once
senses.definitionCN: 一举把对手在各处同时冲垮的选举大胜
senses.example: The opposition rode a tidal wave to a majority.
senses.exampleCN: 反对党乘着一股浪潮取得了多数席位。
senses.why: electoral language borrows the sea for swings that erase the previous map, and a wave that covers everything is the natural image for that.
senses.whyCN: 选举语言借用海洋来描写抹掉旧版图的摆荡，而一道覆盖一切的浪，正是这种事最自然的意象。

senses.title: A category in warnings and policies
senses.titleCN: 警报与保险条款中的类别名
senses.definition: used before another noun as a fixed category in hazard warnings, insurance exclusions and old emergency notices
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，在灾害警报、保险除外条款与旧式紧急通告中作固定类别名
senses.example: The policy excludes loss from tidal wave and earthquake.
senses.exampleCN: 这份保单把潮浪与地震造成的损失列为除外责任。
senses.why: before another noun the phrase stops describing water and hardens into a category name that a warning or a contract can list.
senses.whyCN: 放在另一个名词之前时，短语不再描写水，而固化为一个可以被警报或合同逐条列出的类别名。

intro.en: Tidal wave joins two native Germanic words: tidal is tide plus -al, and wave descends from Old English wǣg 'billow'. The compound named the tide's own wave and the bore before newspapers extended it to tsunamis. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: tidal wave 由两个日耳曼本族词组成：tidal 是 tide 加 -al，wave 则出自古英语 wǣg「巨浪」。这个复合词先指潮汐自身的波与涌潮，后来报纸把它扩展到海啸。年代均为约数。

items.en: Wǣg meant a moving ridge of water, 'billow'; it is the noun that survives as wave and the base of the compound.
items.cn: wǣg 指水中移动的脊，即「巨浪」；它就是留存为 wave 的名词，也是这个复合词的基干。

items.en: Tidal was formed from tide and -al when tide tables needed an adjective for the phenomenon itself; the compound followed once the adjective was available.
items.cn: 潮汐表需要指现象本身的形容词时，tidal 由 tide 加 -al 构成；形容词一旦有了，复合短语随之出现。

items.en: Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century sailing and tide writing used tidal wave for the long wave of the tide and for the bore that runs up a river.
items.cn: 18 与 19 世纪的航海与潮汐写作中，tidal wave 指潮汐的长波，也指逆流而上的涌潮。

items.en: From the nineteenth century, and above all in twentieth-century newspapers, the phrase was attached to seismic sea waves; seismologists objected and adopted tsunami, from Japanese tsu 'harbour' plus nami 'wave'.
items.cn: 从 19 世纪起，尤其到 20 世纪的报纸上，这个短语被安到地震海啸上；地震学家反对这一用法，转而采用源自日语「津波」（港湾之浪）的 tsunami。

items.en: In the twentieth century the phrase also became a standard metaphor for surges of feeling, people, complaints and votes, where nothing watery is involved.
items.cn: 20 世纪，这个短语又成为情感、人群、投诉与选票等涌动的标准比喻，与真正的水已毫无关系。

items.en: Source uncertain (root relation and dates): whether Old English wǣg and the verb wafian descend from one root is disputed, and the exact date when tidal wave was first applied to tsunamis is not fixed; *wēgaz is a reconstructed Germanic form.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根关系与年代）：古英语 wǣg 与动词 wafian 是否同出一根有争议；tidal wave 首次用于海啸的确切年代也没有定论；*wēgaz 是重构的日耳曼形式。

note.en: Group one holds the phrase's own parts, one derivative of its head, and a sound-alike with a different root; group two holds the precise terms that the phrase is often confused with.
note.cn: 第一组是本短语自身的构件、其中心词的一个派生词，以及一个词根不同的同音形近词；第二组是常与本短语混淆的精确术语。

entries.definition: the adjective alone means 'of the tide'; it does not name a wave and cannot stand for the compound.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词单独用时意为「潮汐的」，不指任何波浪，也不能代替整个短语。

entries.definition: the head noun alone covers sea waves, hand gestures and physical waves; only the modifier narrows it to the tide.
entries.definitionCN: 中心名词单独使用时涵盖海浪、挥手与物理波；只有加上修饰语才收窄到潮汐。

entries.definition: wave plus -y, 'having waves in its shape'; it describes hair or lines, never a body of water in motion.
entries.definitionCN: wave 加 -y，意为「呈波浪形的」；它描写头发或线条，从不指运动中的水体。

entries.definition: from Old French weyver 'to abandon', of Scandinavian origin; it sounds exactly like wave but means to give up a right or fee.
entries.definitionCN: 来自古法语 weyver「放弃」，源头在斯堪的纳维亚语；它与 wave 同音，却意为放弃权利或费用。

entries.definition: a sea wave generated by a sea-floor earthquake, landslide or eruption, able to cross an ocean; the correct word where tidal wave is a misnomer.
entries.definitionCN: 由海底地震、滑坡或喷发引起的海浪，可跨越整个大洋；在 tidal wave 属误用之处，它才是正确词。

entries.definition: the steep front of the tide running up a narrow estuary; it is what the original tidal wave often meant, named more exactly.
entries.definitionCN: 潮水在窄河口逆流而上形成的陡立波前；它常是 tidal wave 原义所指，是更精确的名称。

entries.definition: a rise of sea level pushed ashore by storm winds; it is a raised water surface, not a travelling wave.
entries.definitionCN: 风暴风把海水堆向岸边造成的水位上涨；它是被抬高的水面，不是行进中的波。

entries.definition: an exceptionally large single wave arising from the overlap of wave trains; it has no link to tides or earthquakes.
entries.definitionCN: 由多列波叠加而偶然出现的异常单个大浪；与潮汐或地震都无关系。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Two parts: tidal 'of the tide' plus wave 'billow'; the compound first meant the tide's own long wave.
normal.cn: 两个构件：tidal「潮汐的」加 wave「巨浪」；复合词最初指潮汐自身的长波。

normal.en: The family runs tide, tidal, wave, wavy, wavelength, microwave.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 tide、tidal、wave、wavy、wavelength、microwave。

normal.en: The precise term for the estuarine version is tidal bore; the precise term for the seismic version is tsunami.
normal.cn: 河口那一种的精确说法是 tidal bore；地震那一种的精确说法是 tsunami。

normal.en: Seismologists reject tidal wave because tides have nothing to do with earthquakes.
normal.cn: 地震学家不接受 tidal wave 这一说法，因为潮汐与地震毫无关系。

normal.en: The figurative use is countable in phrases: a tidal wave of relief, of complaints, of migration.
normal.cn: 比喻用法在短语中可数：一阵如释重负、一阵投诉、一股移民潮。

abstract.en: Picture a wave so long that its crest passes your boat for half an hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一道浪长到波峰从你的船边经过要半个小时。

abstract.en: Picture a river running backwards with a white line across its width.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河倒流，河面上横着一条白线。

abstract.en: Picture a headline that uses a sea word for something that happened underground.
abstract.cn: 想象一个标题，用海的词去说一件发生在地下的事。

examples.en: A tidal wave of praise greeted the young pianist.
examples.cn: 一片赞誉的浪潮迎接这位年轻钢琴家。

examples.en: Scientists avoid the term tidal wave because it confuses tides with seismic sea waves.
examples.cn: 科学家避免使用 tidal wave 这一说法，因为它把潮汐与地震海啸混为一谈。

examples.en: The bore is the visible tidal wave of a narrow estuary.
examples.cn: 涌潮就是窄河口里看得见的那道潮波。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「潮」加「浪」——潮水推上来的那道浪，像一堵水墙 → 潮汐波、涌潮（也常被误用来指海啸）

root: tidal（古英语 tīd「时间」+ -al）+ wave（古英语 wǣg「巨浪」，日耳曼语重构 *wēgaz）；18—19 世纪航海写作中固定为「潮汐波、涌潮」，19 世纪起被报纸误用于海啸；wave 另有动词来源古英语 wafian「挥动」，两源在现代英语合流。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses trace one phrase as it loosens: the tide's own long wave, its steep front in an estuary, any great wave in casual speech, the newspaper misnomer for a tsunami, and then the figurative surges of feeling, people, messages, votes and finally the category name in warnings and contracts.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项顺着同一个短语的松动过程展开：潮汐自身的长波、它在河口的陡立波前、口语里任何巨浪、报纸对海啸的误称，随后是情感、人群、消息、选票等比喻性涌动，最后是警报与合同里的类别名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall of water pushing upstream against the current, raising the whole surface behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一堵水墙逆流向上游推进，把身后整个水面抬高。

branches.en: SEA WATER MOVING: the long wave of the tide, then its steep visible front in a narrow channel.
branches.cn: 海水在动：先是潮汐的长波，然后是它在窄河道里陡立的可见前缘。

branches.en: THE NAME LOOSENED: any great wave takes the label, and news keeps it for the seismic sea wave.
branches.cn: 名称松脱：任何巨浪都戴上这个标签，新闻又把它留给地震海啸。

branches.en: INWARD AND OUTWARD SURGE: feeling and messages arrive as one unresisting mass.
branches.cn: 向内与向外的涌动：情感与消息都作为一整团无法抵挡的东西到来。

branches.en: CROWDS AND VOTES: people and majorities move like water and erase the old shoreline.
branches.cn: 人群与选票：人与多数像水一样移动，抹掉旧日的岸线。

branches.en: IN CONTRACTS AND WARNINGS: the phrase hardens into a category that can be listed and excluded.
branches.cn: 在合同与警报里：短语固化为一个可以被列出、被排除的类别。

intro.en: Both halves of this phrase are native Germanic words, so the analysis is about compounds and suffixes rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: 这个短语的两半都是日耳曼本族词，因此分析的是复合与后缀，而不是拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin cognate for either part: tide goes back to *tīdiz and wave to *wēgaz. Latin unda 'wave' is a different word altogether, which is why undulate is not a relative of wave, and the Latin entries stay empty.
latinIntro.cn: 两半都没有拉丁同族词：tide 上溯到 *tīdiz，wave 上溯到 *wēgaz。拉丁 unda「波浪」完全是另一个词，因此由它派生的英语词并非 wave 的同族，拉丁条目按实情留空。

items.example: The tide came at its appointed hour.
items.exampleCN: 潮水在约定的时辰到来。

items.example: The same suffix builds tidal from tide.
items.exampleCN: 同一个后缀把 tide 构成 tidal。

items.example: Tidal water fills the creek twice a day.
items.exampleCN: 潮水一天两次灌满这条小溪。

items.example: Old English wǣg named the billow that breaks on the shore.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 wǣg 指拍碎在岸上的巨浪。

items.structure: Old English wafian (verb, 'to move to and fro')
items.meaning: to wave the hand or an object
items.example: Old English wafian meant to move the hand to and fro.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 wafian 意为把手来回挥动。

items.meaning: a sea wave; to move the hand
items.example: She waved from the pier.
items.exampleCN: 她在码头上挥手。

items.example: The wavy line shows the tide's rise.
items.exampleCN: 这条波浪形的线显示潮水的上涨。

items.example: A tide's wavelength is measured in hundreds of kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 潮汐的波长以数百公里计。

items.meaning: the tide's long wave; loosely a tsunami
items.example: The old chart marks the tidal wave's arrival.
items.exampleCN: 旧海图上标着潮汐波的到达时刻。

definition_zh: 波浪；挥手；波（声、光、电磁等）；浪潮；（情绪的）一阵；使成波浪形
definition_en: a ridge of water moving across a surface; also a hand gesture, a physical oscillation, and a surge of events or feeling
core_image: 海面上一道隆起的水脊向前推，到了岸边翻卷、散成白沫
scene: 退潮后的沙滩上，孩子追着一道涌上来的水脊跑，脚背被拍了一下，他说，A wave broke over my feet and pulled the sand from under them.
sceneCN: 这里 wave 指「水面向前推进的隆起水脊」（第 1 个义项：海上的波浪）；句意为：一道浪打过我的脚背，把脚下的沙也抽走了。

pos.zh: 波浪；波（物理）；挥手；浪潮；一阵（情绪）
挥手示意；飘动；使成波浪形

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成：波浪形的；起伏的
由前一形容词加性质名词后缀构成：起伏不平的状态
由本词加表示「长度」的成分构成：波长，两个波峰之间的距离
由本词加表示「形状」的成分构成：波形，信号起伏画出的形状
由表示「微小」的前缀加本词构成：微波；用微波炉加热
由本词加指小后缀构成：小波；信号分析中的小波

senses.title: A ridge on the water
senses.definition: a raised ridge of water travelling across the surface of the sea or a lake, often breaking when it reaches shallow water
senses.definitionCN: 在海面或湖面上向前推进的隆起水脊，到浅水处常会翻卷破碎
senses.example: A wave broke over my feet and pulled the sand from under them.
senses.exampleCN: 一道浪打过我的脚背，把脚下的沙也抽走了。
senses.why: the noun came from Old English wǣg 'billow', the name of a moving ridge of water; this is the literal core that every other sense borrows from.
senses.whyCN: 名词出自古英语 wǣg「巨浪」，本义就是水中移动的脊；这是其余所有义项借用的字面核心。

senses.title: A sign with the hand
senses.definition: a movement of the hand held up and moved from side to side, used to greet, signal or say goodbye
senses.definitionCN: 举起手左右摆动，用来打招呼、示意或告别
senses.example: She gave a quick wave from the platform and disappeared into the train.
senses.exampleCN: 她在站台上匆匆挥了一下手，就消失在车厢里。
senses.why: the noun form of this sense grew from the verb: a single act of moving the hand to and fro was turned into a countable event.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项的名词形式是从动词长出来的：把一次来回动手的动作，变成了一个可数的事件。

senses.title: A physical oscillation
senses.definition: a disturbance that transfers energy through a medium or through space, repeating in time and distance
senses.definitionCN: 在介质或空间中传递能量的扰动，在时间与距离上重复出现
senses.example: Sound travels as a wave that compresses the air in front of it.
senses.exampleCN: 声音以波的形式传播，压缩前方的空气。
senses.why: physics took the water picture and generalised it: anything that repeats through space and time is drawn with the same rising and falling shape.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把水的图像一般化：任何在空间与时间上重复的东西，都用同一种起伏形状来画。

senses.title: A sudden surge of feeling
senses.definition: a sudden rise and passing of a feeling that affects a person or a group
senses.definitionCN: 突然涌起又退去、影响一个人或一群人的情感
senses.example: A wave of relief passed through the ward when the doctor smiled.
senses.exampleCN: 医生一笑，一阵宽慰的波浪掠过病房。
senses.why: a feeling that comes in cycles and then passes behaves like water, so English counts emotions in waves rather than in units.
senses.whyCN: 情绪一波波涌来又退去，行为像水，因此英语用「波」来计数情感，而不是用单个单位。

senses.title: A wave of events
senses.definition: a cluster of similar events arriving close together, as in a crime wave or a wave of protests
senses.definitionCN: 同类事件集中在一段时间内接连发生，如犯罪浪潮或抗议浪潮
senses.example: The city reported a wave of bicycle thefts last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市去年春天报告了一波自行车失窃案。
senses.why: statistics describe clustered events as arriving in successive crests, so a rise in the count is drawn as a wave even when no water is involved.
senses.whyCN: 统计把集中发生的事件说成一个个接连而来的波峰，因此计数上升时，即便没有水，也画成一道浪。

senses.title: A curve in the hair
senses.definition: a curl or series of curves pressed or set into hair
senses.definitionCN: 在头发上做出的卷曲或一连串弧形
senses.example: A single wave in her hair softened the whole portrait.
senses.exampleCN: 她头发上的一道波浪让整幅肖像柔和下来。
senses.why: a lock of hair bent into alternating curves reproduces a water wave in miniature, so hairdressing kept the noun for the shape.
senses.whyCN: 一缕头发弯成交替的弧线，就是水波的缩小版，因此美发业保留了这个名词来指那种形状。

senses.title: A drawn line on an instrument
senses.definition: one rise and fall traced by a signal on a graph, screen or recording
senses.definitionCN: 信号在图表、屏幕或记录上画出的一次起伏
senses.example: The oscilloscope drew a clean wave across the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 示波器在屏幕上画出一道干净的波形。
senses.why: an instrument traces rising and falling voltage as a line, and the drawn shape is literally called a wave, so the graph keeps the sea's name.
senses.whyCN: 仪器把升降的电压画成一条线，画出的形状就被直接叫作波，图表于是沿用了海的名字。

senses.title: To move the hand
senses.definition: to move the hand or an object held in it to and fro, usually as a greeting or signal
senses.definitionCN: 把手或手中的东西来回挥动，通常表示招呼或示意
senses.example: He waved until the car turned the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 他一直挥手，直到汽车转过街角。
senses.why: the verb sense keeps the older gesture meaning, from Old English wafian 'to move to and fro', which is a different source from the noun.
senses.whyCN: 动词义保留较古的手势义，出自古英语 wafian「来回挥动」，与名词的来源并不相同。

senses.title: To set into curves, or flutter
senses.definition: to give hair a wavy shape, or of a flag, cloth or branch, to move in curves in the wind
senses.definitionCN: 把头发做成波浪形；或指旗、布、枝条在风中起伏摆动
senses.example: Flags waved along the pier as the wind rose.
senses.exampleCN: 风起时，码头上的旗子一路飘动。
senses.why: the same verb extends from the hand to anything made to move in curves, from hair set in waves to cloth lifting in the wind.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词从手扩展到任何被弄成曲线运动的东西，从做成波浪的头发到风中掀起的布。

intro.en: Wave has two Old English sources: the noun wǣg 'billow' and the verb wafian 'to move to and fro'. They are generally treated as separate formations that came to share one spelling in Middle English. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: wave 有两个古英语来源：名词 wǣg「巨浪」与动词 wafian「来回挥动」。学界一般把它们视为两个不同的构造，到中古英语才共用同一个拼写。年代均为约数。

items.en: Wǣg meant a moving ridge of water, 'billow, surge'; it is the noun that survives in modern wave and still names the sea's ridge.
items.cn: wǣg 指水中移动的脊，即「巨浪、涌浪」；它就是留存到现代 wave 的名词，仍指海上的水脊。

items.en: The Germanic noun is reconstructed as *wēgaz; it is generally connected with a root meaning 'to carry, move', though that link is a hypothesis rather than a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: 其日耳曼名词重构为 *wēgaz；一般认为它与表示「运送、移动」的词根有关，但这一联系只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Wafian meant 'to move the hand or an object to and fro'; it is a separate verb, not a derivative of the noun wǣg.
items.cn: wafian 意为「把手或物件来回挥动」；它是一个独立的动词，并非名词 wǣg 的派生。

items.en: Both words came to be spelled wave, and the noun widened from a water ridge to a mass of advancing troops, events or feeling.
items.cn: 两个词都写成 wave，名词也从水脊扩展到推进的人群、事件或情感。

items.en: Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century physics began drawing waves on paper, and the vocabulary of wavelength, waveform and wave theory followed.
items.cn: 18 与 19 世纪的物理学开始在纸上画波，wavelength、waveform 与波理论等词汇随之出现。

items.en: Source uncertain (root relation, not first date): whether wǣg and wafian descend from a single root is disputed, and they are usually described as two formations that merged in spelling; the date of the first figurative wave of is approximate, and *wēgaz is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（指词根关系，不是首见年代）：wǣg 与 wafian 是否同出一根有争议，通常被描述为两个构造在拼写上合并；最早的比喻搭配（「一波……」这类说法）年代只是约数，*wēgaz 属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds the derived forms of wave and one sound-alike with a different root; group two holds the sea words that differ in size, shape or behaviour.
note.cn: 第一组是 wave 的派生形式，以及一个词根不同的同音形近词；第二组是规模、形状或行为不同的海面用词。

entries.definition: from Old French weyver 'to abandon', probably of Scandinavian origin; it sounds identical to wave but means to give up a right, fee or rule.
entries.definitionCN: 来自古法语 weyver「放弃」，源头可能在斯堪的纳维亚语；它与 wave 同音，却意为放弃权利、费用或规则。

entries.definition: wave plus -y: having a shape that rises and falls in curves, used of hair, lines and edges.
entries.definitionCN: wave 加 -y：形状呈起伏的曲线，多用于头发、线条与边缘。

entries.definition: the distance between two successive crests; it is a measurement, not an object you can see on the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 相邻两个波峰之间的距离；它是一个量值，不是海上看得见的物体。

entries.definition: wave plus -let 'small': a small wave, and in modern signal analysis a short, localised wave shape.
entries.definitionCN: wave 加指小后缀 -let：小浪；在现代信号分析中指短而局部化的波形。

entries.definition: a long regular rise of the sea, often from distant weather, that has not yet steepened or broken.
entries.definitionCN: 海面上长而规则的起伏，常来自远处的天气，尚未变陡或破碎。

entries.definition: a very small wave on a surface, usually made by a light wind or a thrown stone.
entries.definitionCN: 水面极小的波，通常由微风或投石造成。

entries.definition: a wave that has begun to curl and fall as it reaches shallow water or a reef.
entries.definitionCN: 到达浅水或礁石时开始卷起、崩落的浪。

entries.definition: a great rolling mass of water, cloud or smoke; it stresses volume and movement rather than a single crest.
entries.definitionCN: 水、云或烟的一大团翻滚体；它强调体积与运动，而非单个波峰。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The noun is Old English wǣg 'billow'; the verb is wafian 'move the hand' — two sources, one spelling.
normal.cn: 名词是古英语 wǣg「巨浪」，动词是 wafian「挥动手」——两个来源，一个拼写。

normal.en: The family runs wave, wavy, waviness, wavelength, waveform, microwave, wavelet.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 wave、wavy、waviness、wavelength、waveform、microwave、wavelet。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the physics: sound wave, shock wave, light wave, wave height.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出物理义：声波、冲击波、光波、波高。

normal.en: Figurative waves are counted: a wave of relief, a crime wave, a wave of protests.
normal.cn: 比喻的波可以计数：一阵宽慰、一波犯罪、一波抗议。

normal.en: One word covers hand and water because both go up and down and come back again.
normal.cn: 一个词同时覆盖手与水，因为两者都是上下往复。

abstract.en: Picture a single crest that keeps its shape while the water inside it stays almost in place.
abstract.cn: 想象一道波峰保持形状往前，而构成它的水几乎停在原处。

abstract.en: Picture a hand and a swell making the same arc in the air.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手与一道涌浪在空中画出同一条弧。

abstract.en: Picture a microphone drawing a line that rises and falls like water.
abstract.cn: 想象一支麦克风画出一条像水一样起伏的线。

examples.en: The buoy recorded a wave nearly twelve metres high.
examples.cn: 浮标记录到一道近十二米高的浪。

examples.en: She waved from the window until the bus was out of sight.
examples.cn: 她在窗前挥手，直到公交车看不见为止。

examples.en: A wave of new students filled the lecture hall in September.
examples.cn: 九月，一波新生坐满了讲堂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「挥」——挥手是 wave，海浪一来一回也像在挥手 → 波浪、挥手、波动

root: 名词古英语 wǣg「浪、波涛」（日耳曼语重构 *wēgaz，一般认为是印欧「运送、移动」词根的派生）；动词古英语 wafian「来回挥动」；两源在中古英语合为 wave，现代义由水浪扩展到挥手、物理波与「浪潮」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses split between two old sources: the sea's ridge and its physical descendants, then the hand's gesture and everything else that moves to and fro in curves, with the counted surge of feeling and events in between.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项分属两个古老来源：先是由海浪扩展出的物理义，再是手势以及一切来回成曲线运动的东西，中间夹着可计数的情感与事件涌动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ridge of water moving forward while the water itself only rises and falls in place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道水脊向前推进，而构成它的水只是原地上下起伏。

branches.en: THE DRAWN SHAPE: the sea's ridge and the oscilloscope's curve are one geometry seen twice.
branches.cn: 被画出的形状：海上的水脊与示波器上的曲线，是同一种几何看了两遍。

branches.en: THE HAND: the noun of greeting and the verb of greeting are the same gesture in two grammatical shapes.
branches.cn: 手：招呼的名词与动词，是同一个手势的两种语法形态。

branches.en: THE GENERALISED MOTION: physics extends the ridge to sound and light, and the verb to flags and hair.
branches.cn: 被推广的运动：物理学把水脊扩展到声与光，动词则扩展到旗与头发。

branches.en: SURGES COUNTED: feelings pass in crests, and social statistics cluster in waves.
branches.cn: 可计数的涌动：情感一波波过去，社会统计也一波波聚集。

branches.en: THE SHAPE IN HAIR: a curl repeats the water curve in miniature.
branches.cn: 头发里的形状：一道卷发把水的曲线缩小重演。

intro.en: Wave is a native Germanic word; its family grows by suffixes and compounds, and the same shape-word serves physics, hairdressing and signal analysis.
intro.cn: wave 是日耳曼本族词；它的词族靠后缀与复合扩展，同一个「形状词」同时服务物理学、美发与信号分析。

latinIntro.en: Latin has no cognate for wave: its word for a wave was unda, which gives English undulate but is unrelated to wave. That is why the Latin entries stay empty, and only the borrowed suffix -al appears elsewhere in the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语没有 wave 的同族词：它表示波浪的词是 unda，由此产生的英语词与 wave 并无亲缘。因此拉丁条目留空；词族里唯一的外来成分是别处出现的后缀 -al。

items.example: Old English wǣg named the billow that breaks on the shore.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 wǣg 指拍碎在岸上的巨浪。

items.structure: Old English wafian (verb, 'to move to and fro')
items.example: Old English wafian meant to move the hand to and fro.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 wafian 意为把手来回挥动。

items.meaning: a sea wave; to move the hand
items.example: Wave your hand when the boat comes.
items.exampleCN: 船来的时候挥挥手。

items.example: The wavy edge follows the old shoreline.
items.exampleCN: 那条波浪形的边缘沿着旧岸线走。

items.example: The waviness of the glass distorts the horizon.
items.exampleCN: 玻璃的起伏把地平线弄歪了。

items.example: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue.
items.exampleCN: 红光的波长比蓝光长。

items.example: The waveform flattened after the filter.
items.exampleCN: 滤波之后波形变平了。

items.example: Microwave links carry the signal inland.
items.exampleCN: 微波链路把信号送向内陆。

items.meaning: a small wave; a short localised waveform
items.example: A wavelet crossed the quiet harbour.
items.exampleCN: 一道小浪掠过平静的港湾。

definition_zh: 振幅；幅度；（天体的）出没方位角；充足；丰富
definition_en: the maximum distance a vibrating thing moves from its resting position; also the size or extent of a change, and, in older use, abundance
core_image: 一根绷紧的弦上下摆动，从中间那条静止线到最高点的距离，就是振幅
scene: 物理实验室里，学生把尺子贴在振动的弦旁，指着摆动的边缘说，The amplitude of the swing decides how loud the note will sound.
sceneCN: 这里 amplitude 指「振动体离开平衡位置的最大距离」（第 1 个义项：一般意义上的振幅）；句意为：摆动的振幅决定这个音听起来有多响。

pos.zh: 振幅；幅度；（天体的）出没方位角
充足；丰盈；广阔

derivatives.zh: 拉丁 amplus「大的」经古法语进入英语：充足的；宽敞的（同根形容词）
拉丁 amplificare（amplus + -ficare「使」）：放大；增强；详述
由同根动词加过程名词后缀构成：放大；增强；详述
由同根动词加施动者后缀构成：放大器
由本词加形容词后缀构成（罕用）：幅度的；宽广的

senses.title: The greatest swing from rest
senses.titleCN: 振动离开平衡位置的最大距离
senses.definition: the maximum displacement of a vibrating body or particle from its equilibrium position
senses.definitionCN: 振动着的物体或质点离开平衡位置的最大位移
senses.example: The amplitude of the swing decides how loud the note will sound.
senses.exampleCN: 摆动的振幅决定这个音听起来有多响。
senses.why: Latin amplitudo named width and largeness; physics kept the idea of 'how far out from the middle' and fixed it as the greatest distance reached.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 amplitudo 本指宽度与广大；物理学保留「离中间有多远」这一观念，并把它固定为所能达到的最大距离。

senses.title: The height of a drawn wave
senses.titleCN: 波形图上从零线到波峰的高度
senses.definition: on a graph of a wave, the distance from the centre line to a crest or from the centre line to a trough
senses.definitionCN: 在波的图形上，从中心线到波峰、或从中心线到波谷的距离
senses.example: On the graph the amplitude is the height from the centre line to the crest.
senses.exampleCN: 在图上，振幅就是从中心线到波峰的高度。
senses.why: a wave drawn on paper has a middle line, so its size is read as the distance from that line to the peak, and a word for width becomes a word for height.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的波有一条中心线，它的大小就按中心线到峰顶的距离来读，一个表宽度的词于是变成了表高度的词。

senses.title: The arc on the horizon
senses.definition: in navigation and astronomy, the arc of the horizon between the east or west point and the point where a heavenly body rises or sets
senses.definitionCN: 在航海与天文中，地平线上正东点或正西点与天体出没点之间的弧
senses.example: The navigator took the sun's amplitude to check the compass.
senses.exampleCN: 领航员测了太阳的出没方位角来校对罗盘。
senses.why: in navigation the 'width' is an angle measured along the horizon, so a word for broadness came to name the breadth of an arc and a practical check on a compass.
senses.whyCN: 在航海里，这个「宽度」是沿地平线量出的角，因此一个表宽阔的词，转而指一段弧的宽度，也成了一种实用的罗盘校验。

senses.title: The swing of a variable star
senses.definition: the half-range of a star's brightness variation, quoted in magnitudes on its light curve
senses.definitionCN: 恒星亮度变化的半个幅度，以其光变曲线上的星等表示
senses.example: The variable star's amplitude is measured in magnitudes.
senses.exampleCN: 这颗变星的振幅以星等来计量。
senses.why: a star that brightens and dims traces a curve, and the half-height of that curve is its amplitude, borrowed straight from the drawing of waves.
senses.whyCN: 一颗明暗变化的星会画出一条曲线，曲线高度的一半就是它的振幅，这一用法直接借自画波的做法。

senses.title: The strength of a sound
senses.definition: the extent of the pressure swing in a sound wave, which a listener hears as loudness
senses.definitionCN: 声波中压力起伏的幅度，听者感知为响度
senses.example: The microphone clipped when the amplitude exceeded its range.
senses.exampleCN: 振幅超出量程时，麦克风削顶了。
senses.why: a sound is a pressure wave, and a larger swing of pressure is heard as a louder note, so the physical measure stands for the sensation.
senses.whyCN: 声音是压力波，压力起伏越大，听上去就越响，于是这个物理量直接代表听感。

senses.title: The size of an electrical signal
senses.definition: the magnitude of a voltage or current swing in a circuit or transmitted signal
senses.definitionCN: 电路或传输信号中电压或电流起伏的大小
senses.example: The filter cut the signal's amplitude by half.
senses.exampleCN: 滤波器把信号的幅度削去了一半。
senses.why: an electrical signal is a wave of voltage, so engineers quote its strength as amplitude rather than as a power, keeping the graph's vocabulary.
senses.whyCN: 电信号是电压的波，工程师因此用幅度而非功率来报它的强弱，沿用了图形的词汇。

senses.title: The height of a seismic trace
senses.titleCN: 地震记录上波动的幅度
senses.definition: the height of the first swing recorded by a seismograph, used to compare the size of ground motion
senses.definitionCN: 地震仪记录到的第一次摆动的高度，用来比较地面运动的强弱
senses.example: Seismographs compare the amplitude of the first arrival with a standard.
senses.exampleCN: 地震仪把初至波的振幅与一个标准值比较。
senses.why: a seismogram is a drawn wave too, and the height of its first swing is what the magnitude scale reads, so the sea's measure became a measure of earthquakes.
senses.whyCN: 地震记录同样是一条画出的波，量级标度读的就是它第一次摆动的高度，海上的量于是成了地震的量。

senses.title: The extent of a change
senses.definition: the size or reach of a change, difference or effect in an abstract sense
senses.definitionCN: 抽象意义上的变化、差异或影响的大小与所及范围
senses.example: Few expected the amplitude of the reform to be so great.
senses.exampleCN: 很少有人料到这场改革的幅度会这么大。
senses.why: the old sense of 'width, largeness' survives in abstract use: the amplitude of a change is how far it reaches, not how tall it is.
senses.whyCN: 「宽度、广大」的旧义在抽象用法中留存：变化的幅度指它波及多远，而不是它有多高。

senses.title: Archaic abundance
senses.definition: in older writing, fullness, plenty, or largeness of means and supply
senses.definitionCN: 在较古的写作中，指充实、丰足，或财力物力的宽裕
senses.example: The estate was praised for the amplitude of its harvests.
senses.exampleCN: 这座庄园因收成丰足而受到称赞。
senses.why: the earliest English sense was abundance and largeness of means; the measuring sense came later and pushed this sense into older writing.
senses.whyCN: 英语中最早的义项是丰足与财力宽裕；测量的义项来得较晚，把这个义项挤进了较古的文本。

intro.en: Amplitude is built from Latin amplus 'large, spacious' plus the noun suffix -tudo, giving amplitudo 'breadth, extent, abundance'; it reached English through French in the seventeenth century, and the physics sense was fixed in the nineteenth. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: amplitude 由拉丁 amplus「大的、宽广的」加名词后缀 -tudo 构成，得 amplitudo「宽广、幅度、丰足」；17 世纪经法语进入英语，物理义到 19 世纪才定型。年代均为约数。

items.en: Amplus meant 'large, spacious, abundant' and is also the base of English ample and of the verb amplificare behind amplify.
items.cn: amplus 意为「大的、宽广的、充足的」，它也是英语 ample 以及 amplify 背后的动词 amplificare 的基干。

items.en: Amplitudo, from amplus plus -tudo, named breadth, extent and abundance; -tudo is the source of the English ending -tude in magnitude-type nouns.
items.cn: amplitudo 由 amplus 加 -tudo 构成，指宽广、幅度与丰足；-tudo 就是英语 magnitude 一类名词词尾 -tude 的来源。

items.en: French amplitude carried the word into English in the seventeenth century, where it first meant largeness and abundance rather than a measured swing.
items.cn: 法语的 amplitude 在 17 世纪把这个词带进英语，当时它先指广大与丰足，而不是可测量的摆幅。

items.en: Seventeenth- and eighteenth-century astronomy gave amplitude a precise angle: the arc of the horizon between the east or west point and the point where a body rises or sets.
items.cn: 17 与 18 世纪的天文航海学给 amplitude 一个精确的角度义：地平线上正东或正西点与天体出没点之间的弧。

items.en: Wave theory fixed amplitude as the maximum displacement from equilibrium, and the word moved from 'breadth' to 'height of a swing'.
items.cn: 波动理论把 amplitude 固定为离开平衡位置的最大位移，这个词也从「宽度」转向「摆动的高度」。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root, not first date): the origin of Latin amplus is disputed, with proposals linking it to roots meaning 'to grasp' or 'to spread'; any Indo-European form is a reconstruction. The first English citation is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（指更深的词根，不是首见年代）：拉丁 amplus 的来源有争议，有把它联系到「抓取」或「铺展」类词根的假说；任何印欧语形式都是重构。英语最早书证只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds two same-root relatives and two look-alikes from different roots; group two holds the quantities that are often confused with amplitude in measuring.
note.cn: 第一组是两个同根亲属词与两个词根不同的形近词；第二组是在测量中常与振幅混淆的量。

entries.definition: from Latin amplus 'large': plentiful, more than enough; it keeps the old sense that amplitude once had.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 amplus「大的」：充足的、绰绰有余的；它保留了 amplitude 曾经拥有的旧义。

entries.definition: amplus plus -ficare 'to make': to make something larger, especially a signal or a sound.
entries.definitionCN: amplus 加 -ficare「使」：使某物变大，尤指信号或声音。

entries.definition: from Latin aptus 'fit': natural ability. It ends like amplitude but contains no idea of width.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 aptus「适合的」：天资、才能。它与 amplitude 词尾相同，却不含任何「宽」的观念。

entries.definition: from Latin latus 'wide', a different 'width' word: distance north or south of the equator, and also freedom of action.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 latus「宽的」，是另一个表「宽」的词：纬度，也指行动的余地。

entries.definition: the size of a quantity on a scale, without direction; it is broader than amplitude and needs no zero line.
entries.definitionCN: 某量在标度上的大小，不带方向；它比振幅更宽，也不需要中心零线。

entries.definition: power carried per unit area; for a wave it grows with the square of the amplitude, so it is not the same quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 单位面积携带的功率；对波而言，它随振幅的平方增长，因此并非同一个量。

entries.definition: the distance a point has moved from rest at a given instant; amplitude is its maximum over a cycle.
entries.definitionCN: 某一瞬间质点离开静止位置的距离；振幅是一个周期内的最大值。

entries.definition: the distance from a trough to a crest; it equals twice the amplitude, so the two numbers differ by a factor of two.
entries.definitionCN: 从波谷到波峰的距离；等于振幅的两倍，两个数值相差一倍。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin amplus 'large' plus -tudo: amplitude is 'largeness' turned into something measurable.
normal.cn: 拉丁 amplus「大的」加 -tudo：amplitude 就是「大」被变成可测之物。

normal.en: The family runs ample, amplify, amplification, amplifier, amplitude.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 ample、amplify、amplification、amplifier、amplitude。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the technical sense: wave amplitude, peak amplitude, amplitude modulation, tidal amplitude.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出技术义：波幅、峰值振幅、调幅、潮汐振幅。

normal.en: Amplitude is half the peak-to-peak distance and the square root of intensity.
normal.cn: 振幅是峰峰值的一半，也是强度的平方根。

normal.en: The old sense survives in 'the amplitude of the harvest': plenty, not a graph.
normal.cn: 旧义仍存于「收成的丰足」这一说法：说的是丰盈，不是图形。

abstract.en: Picture a pendulum's arc, widest at the ends and still at the centre.
abstract.cn: 想象钟摆的弧线，两端最远，中间静止。

abstract.en: Picture a sound made louder without changing its pitch: the wave grows taller, not faster.
abstract.cn: 想象一个音变响而音高不变：波变高了，而不是变快了。

abstract.en: Picture a word that once meant 'plenty' reduced to the height of a curve.
abstract.cn: 想象一个曾表示「丰足」的词，最后缩成一条曲线的高度。

examples.en: A larger amplitude means a louder sound only if the frequency stays the same.
examples.cn: 只有在频率不变时，更大的振幅才意味着更响的声音。

examples.en: The tide's amplitude is half its range, measured from mean water.
examples.cn: 潮汐的振幅是潮差的一半，从平均水位量起。

examples.en: The amplitude of the temperature swing surprised the farmers.
examples.cn: 气温摆动的幅度让农民们吃惊。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安普」加「充足」——ample 是充足，充足到极点，就是摆动的最大幅度 → 振幅、幅度

root: 拉丁 amplus「大的、宽广的、充足的」+ 名词后缀 -tudo（英语作 -tude）→ 拉丁 amplitudo「宽广、幅度、丰足」→ 法语 amplitude → 英语 amplitude；amplus 的更早来源存疑，相关印欧词根均属构拟。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses all measure 'how far out': the greatest swing from rest, the height on a graph, an arc on the horizon, a star's half-range, a sound's pressure, a signal's voltage, a seismic trace, the reach of a change, and finally the archaic plenty from which the word began.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都在量「离开多远」：离静止位置的最大摆幅、图形上的高度、地平线上的一段弧、恒星的半个变幅、声音的压力起伏、信号的电压、地震记录的摆动、变化所及的范围，最后是这个词最初的「丰足」古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a string swinging away from its resting line, and the distance from that line to the farthest point it reaches.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根弦从静止线摆开，以及从那条线到它所能到达的最远点的距离。

branches.en: MEASURING A SWING: the greatest distance from rest, then the same height read off a drawn curve.
branches.cn: 量一次摆动：先是离静止位置的最大距离，然后是从画出的曲线上读出的同一高度。

branches.en: MEASURING THE SKY: an arc along the horizon and the half-height of a star's light curve carry the same name.
branches.cn: 量天空：地平线上的一段弧与恒星光变曲线的一半高度，都叫这个名字。

branches.en: MEASURING WHAT TRAVELS: sound pressure and voltage are both read by the size of their swing.
branches.cn: 量传递之物：声压与电压都按摆幅大小来读。

branches.en: MEASURING GROUND AND CHANGE: the first swing of a seismogram and the reach of a reform use one word.
branches.cn: 量大地与变化：地震记录的第一次摆动，与一场改革所及的范围，用的是同一个词。

branches.en: THE OLD SENSE: before it measured anything, the word meant plenty.
branches.cn: 旧义：在它开始测量任何东西之前，这个词表示丰足。

intro.en: Amplitude is a Latin abstract noun: the adjective amplus supplies the root, -tudo supplies the quality, and the same root recurs in ample, amplify and amplifier.
intro.cn: amplitude 是拉丁抽象名词：形容词 amplus 提供词根，-tudo 提供性质，同一词根又出现在 ample、amplify 与 amplifier 中。

latinIntro.en: Latin amplus gives amplitudo and the verb amplificare, whose English descendant is amplify; the suffixes -tudo and -ficare are the two productive pieces behind the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 amplus 衍生出 amplitudo 与动词 amplificare，后者在英语的后代就是 amplify；-tudo 与 -ficare 这两个能产后缀支撑起整个词族。

items.structure: amplus, ampla, amplum (adj., first and second declension)
items.example: Amplus describes both space and supply.
items.exampleCN: amplus 既描写空间，也描写供给。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀
items.example: Amplitudo follows the same pattern as magnitudo.
items.exampleCN: amplitudo 与 magnitudo 循同一构词模式。

items.example: Amplitudo covered both width and plenty.
items.exampleCN: amplitudo 同时涵盖宽度与丰足。

items.example: The amplitude of the wave was recorded.
